$comment: Reviewed input to tools/ZabbixApiExtract: what the Zabbix source cannot say in a form an analysis reads. objects/types/methods: the C# names (stable across regenerations) and the documentation sentences, keyed by wire name (seeded once from the retired src/-reflected description; never structure). enums: C# names for define families. fieldEnums: the family a field's values come from when no rule names it (read-only fields); each value is a define prefix, 'PREFIX#flags' for a bit set, or a list of define names. keepEnums: 0/1 families that stay enums. serverDefines: the server's C defines a read field's values are where no PHP file declares them, each with its source; they join every version's defines. objects.<object>.help: the PowerShell help's words for the object (noun, plural, role, a sample name, the create and change arguments of its examples), which the generated cmdlets' synopses, descriptions and examples are composed from, and, for tools/Test-ZbxHelpExamples.ps1, which runs the examples against a live server: notRun, why it does not run an example (keyed by the example's title or its command's verb), and liveSetup, a command the lab needs before the object's examples run. notFields: fields a read (keyed by object) or a request or get (keyed by object.method) does not have although a table or a shared validation names them, each with its source; enums.<family>.memberSummaries: a member's own sentence. selects/readFields/objectTables/extraFields: facts the PHP computes at run time, each with the source that states it in its '_source'. objects.<object>.idField: the read model's own id where the delete names none; objects.<object>.requiredWhen: a field required only under a condition a run-time rule class decides, with the condition. references: the object an id field refers to (ids, by wire name; owners, where an object's requests and get name another). cmdlets: the PowerShell module's reviewed shape where no rule over the model decides it (see its own _comment). All three are carried into zabbix-api.json and checked against the model by the merge.

action.summary: An action reacts to events: when its conditions match a trigger, discovery, autoregistration, internal or service event, it sends messages, runs scripts or changes hosts.

apiinfo.summary: The API information object: the version of the Zabbix API a server runs, readable without logging in.

autoregistration.summary: The server's autoregistration settings: which TLS connections an active agent may autoregister with, and the PSK it presents.

configuration.summary: Configuration export and import: hosts, templates, maps, media types and other objects as one JSON, XML or YAML document.

history.summary: A history record is one value an item collected, with its clock; history is kept for each item's history period, then only as hourly trends.

help.role: of the values items collected

hostinterface.summary: A host interface is an address a host is polled on: a Zabbix agent, SNMP, IPMI or JMX endpoint with its IP address or DNS name and port.

help.role: that hosts are polled on

hostprototype.summary: A host prototype is the pattern a discovery rule turns into one host per entity it finds, such as a virtual machine of a hypervisor.

help.role: that discovery rules turn into hosts

host.summary: A host is a monitored device, server or application: a name, the groups it is in, the interfaces it is polled on, and the items, triggers and templates that monitor it.

help.role: that Zabbix monitors

housekeeping.summary: The server's housekeeping settings: how long history, trends, events, sessions and audit records are kept before the housekeeper deletes them.

httptest.summary: A web scenario checks a web application: a sequence of HTTP requests whose status codes, content and response times become items.

iconmap.summary: An icon map picks a map element's icon from the host's inventory, such as a router icon for every host whose inventory type is router.

help.role: that pick map icons from host inventory

help.role: that maps show

itemprototype.summary: An item prototype is the pattern a discovery rule turns into one item per entity it finds, such as the used space of each file system.

help.role: that discovery rules turn into items

help.role: that cover planned work

map.summary: A network map draws hosts, host groups, triggers and other maps as icons joined by links, colored by the problems behind them.

help.role: that draw hosts and their problems

mediatype.summary: A media type is how Zabbix delivers a message: email, SMS, a script, or a webhook to a chat or ticketing system.

help.role: that deliver messages

mfa.summary: A multi-factor authentication method asks users for a second factor at login: a time-based one-time password or Duo Universal Prompt.

help.role: that ask users for a second factor
help.changeNote: Makes {target} ask for eight-digit codes.

module.summary: A frontend module adds widgets or pages to the Zabbix frontend; it is listed once its files are in the frontend's modules folder, and runs once enabled.

help.role: that add widgets and pages to the frontend
help.changeNote: Disables {target}, so the frontend stops loading it.

notRun.Remove: The lab frontend has no registered module of its own to delete but the stock widgets, which the examples leave alone.

dcheck.summary: A network discovery check is one probe of a network discovery rule: a Zabbix agent key, an SNMP OID, ICMP ping or a service port such as SSH or HTTP.

help.role: that network discovery rules run

drule.summary: A network discovery rule scans IP ranges on a schedule with its checks and reports the hosts and services it finds, for discovery actions to act on.

help.role: that scan IP ranges for hosts and services

problem.summary: A problem is a trigger, item or discovery event that is still unresolved, with its severity, acknowledgements and tags.

help.role: that are still unresolved

proxygroup.summary: A proxy group shares its hosts among its proxies and moves them to another proxy of the group when one goes offline (Zabbix 7.0 and later).

help.role: that share hosts among proxies
help.changeNote: Makes {target} need two proxies online to be online itself.

proxy.summary: A proxy collects data for the server from the hosts assigned to it, so a remote site needs only one connection to the server.

help.role: that collect data for the server

regexp.summary: A global regular expression is a named set of expressions that log items, low-level discovery filters and other fields refer to as @name.

help.role: that log items and discovery filters refer to
help.changeNote: Sets the text the frontend tests {target} against.

report.summary: A scheduled report sends a PDF of a dashboard by email to users and user groups, daily, weekly, monthly or yearly.

help.role: that email dashboards on a schedule
help.changeNote: Disables {target}, so it is not sent until it is enabled again.
help.createNote: -Weekdays is a bit set of the days a weekly report goes out, 1 for Monday to 64 for Sunday; the command writes the new report, read back from the server.

role.summary: A user role sets what its users may see and do: the user type, the frontend sections, the API methods and the actions they may run.

help.role: that set what users may see and do
help.changeNote: Renames {target} to Read-only support.

script.summary: A script is a command, webhook or URL users run from a host or event menu, or an action runs as an operation.

help.role: that users and actions run
help.changeNote: Makes {target} ask for confirmation before it runs.

service.summary: A service models a business service as a tree whose status follows its child services and the problems tagged for it, for SLA reporting.

help.role: that model business services
help.changeNote: Sets the description of {target}.

settings.summary: The frontend's global settings: the default theme, work period, severity names and colors, and the other options of Administration > General.

sla.summary: A service level agreement sets the uptime a set of services should reach in each reporting period, and reports what they reached.

help.role: that set the uptime services should reach
help.changeNote: Lowers the objective of {target} to 99.5 percent.

task.summary: A task asks the server to do something now: check items, collect diagnostic information or reload a proxy's configuration.

templatedashboard.summary: A template dashboard is a dashboard a template defines; each host linked to the template shows it with that host's data.

help.role: that templates define for their hosts
help.changeNote: Makes {target} show each page for 60 seconds in slide show mode.

templategroup.summary: A template group is a named set of templates; permissions select templates by their groups.

help.role: that organize templates
help.changeNote: Renames {target} to Templates/Database servers.

template.summary: A template is a reusable set of items, triggers, graphs, discovery rules and dashboards; linking it to a host gives the host all of them.

help.role: that hosts are linked to
help.changeNote: Sets the description of {target}.

token.summary: An API token logs a user in to the API without a password; it is created without its secret, which the server generates once (token.generate).

help.role: that log users in to the API
help.changeNote: Disables {target}, so the API refuses it.

trend.summary: A trend record is one hour of an item's numeric values folded to their minimum, average, maximum and count, kept after the raw history ages out.

triggerprototype.summary: A trigger prototype is the pattern a discovery rule turns into one trigger per entity it finds.

help.role: that discovery rules turn into triggers
help.changeNote: Makes the triggers made from {target} raise high-severity problems.

trigger.summary: A trigger is a problem expression over item values; when it becomes true the trigger goes into the problem state and raises an event.

userdirectory.summary: A user directory is an LDAP server or a SAML identity provider that users authenticate against and, with provisioning, are created from.

help.role: that users authenticate against

usergroup.summary: A user group is a named set of users that sets their permissions on host and template groups, their frontend access and their authentication.

help.role: that set users' permissions

usermacro.summary: A user macro is a named value, such as {$APP.PORT}, that items, triggers and other fields refer to; a host or template macro overrides a global one.

help.role: that items and triggers refer to

user.summary: A user is an account that logs in to the frontend or the API, with its role, its user groups and the media it is notified on.

help.role: that log in to Zabbix

valuemap.summary: A value map turns raw item values into words, such as 1 into Up and 0 into Down, for the frontend and notifications.

help.role: that turn item values into words
help.changeNote: Renames {target} to Service state (up/down).

hostdashboard.summary: A host dashboard is a dashboard of a template, shown on each host the template is linked to, with that host's data.

help.role: that a host shows from its templates

ceprule.summary: An event processing rule matches incoming events against a filter within a time window and applies its operations to them, in sort order (Zabbix 8.0 and later).

help.role: that process incoming events
help.create: -Position 1 -Description 'Tags the alerts of the web tier' -Operation @{ sortorder = 1; execute_when = 0; type = 11; tag = 'tier'; tag_value = 'web' }

device.summary: A device is a client a user enrolled with Zabbix through an enrollment token, with its status and when it was last seen (Zabbix 8.0 and later).

help.role: that users enrolled

notRun.Get a device by name: A device is enrolled from the Zabbix mobile app: the API cannot create one, and a lab server has none to find.

serverinfo.summary: The server information object: what the connected Zabbix server reports about itself (Zabbix 8.0 and later).

apmlog.summary: The APM log entry: a line of application log output collected by application performance monitoring, read by time window (Zabbix 8.0 and later).

apmmetric.summary: The APM metric sample: a measurement collected by application performance monitoring, read by time window (Zabbix 8.0 and later).

apmspan.summary: The APM span: one timed operation of a trace collected by application performance monitoring, read by time window (Zabbix 8.0 and later).

apmtrace.summary: The APM trace: a request's spans collected by application performance monitoring, read by time window (Zabbix 8.0 and later).

ActionGetParameters.summary: Query parameters for the action .get API method.

output.name: Output
output.summary: The action properties to return, either as a list of property names or as extend for all of them; extend is the default.

filter.name: Filter
filter.summary: Return only actions whose properties exactly match the given values; each key is a property name and each value is a single value or an array of accepted values.

search.name: Search
search.summary: Return only actions whose string properties match the given patterns; by default a property matches when it contains the text, without regard to case.

searchWildcardsEnabled.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
searchWildcardsEnabled.summary: When true, an asterisk in a search pattern matches any sequence of characters.

searchByAny.name: SearchByAny
searchByAny.summary: When true, return actions that match any of the search patterns instead of all of them.

startSearch.name: StartSearch
startSearch.summary: When true, a search pattern matches only at the start of the property value instead of anywhere in it.

excludeSearch.name: ExcludeSearch
excludeSearch.summary: When true, return actions that do not match the search patterns.

limit.name: Limit
limit.summary: The maximum number of actions to return.

sortfield.name: SortField
sortfield.summary: The properties to sort actions by; accepted values are actionid, name and status.

sortorder.name: SortOrder
sortorder.summary: The direction for each sort property: ASC for ascending, the default, or DESC for descending.

countOutput.name: CountOutput
countOutput.summary: When true, return the number of matching actions instead of the records.

preservekeys.name: PreserveKeys

actionids.name: ActionIds

Alert.summary: The alert read model, as returned by the Zabbix API.

actionid.name: ActionId
actionid.summary: The action that produced the alert, by ID.

eventid.name: EventId
eventid.summary: ID of the event that generated the alert.

userid.name: UserId
userid.summary: The recipient user of the message, by ID.

clock.name: Clock
clock.summary: Time the alert was generated, as a Unix timestamp.

mediatypeid.name: MediaTypeId
mediatypeid.summary: The media type that delivered the message, by ID.

sendto.name: SendTo
sendto.summary: Address, user name or other recipient identifier the message was sent to. Applies to message alerts.

subject.name: Subject
subject.summary: Subject of the message. Applies to message alerts.

message.name: Message
message.summary: Body of the message. Applies to message alerts.

status.name: Status
status.summary: Whether the alert went out: not sent yet, sent, failed, or new (<c>ALERT_STATUS_*</c>).

retries.name: Retries
retries.summary: How many delivery attempts Zabbix made for the message.

error.name: Error
error.summary: Why sending the alert failed; empty when it did not.

alerttype.name: AlertType
alerttype.summary: Whether the alert is a message or a remote command.

p_eventid.name: PEventId
p_eventid.summary: ID of the problem event, for an alert generated by its recovery or an update; 0 otherwise.

acknowledgeid.name: AcknowledgeId
acknowledgeid.summary: ID of the problem update that generated the alert, or 0 when the alert does not come from an update.

esc_step.summary: Escalation step of the action during which the alert was generated.

AlertGetParameters.summary: Query parameters for the alert .get API method.

output.name: Output
output.summary: The alert properties to return: a list of property names, or extend for all of them. The object ID is always included. Defaults to extend.

filter.name: Filter
filter.summary: Exact-match filter: an object whose keys are alert properties and whose values are a single value or an array of accepted values. Text-type properties are not supported.

search.name: Search
search.summary: Case-insensitive pattern search: an object whose keys are alert properties and whose values are substrings to look for. By default a value matches anywhere in the property.

searchWildcardsEnabled.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
searchWildcardsEnabled.summary: If true, an asterisk in a search value acts as a wildcard. Defaults to false.

searchByAny.name: SearchByAny
searchByAny.summary: If true, return results that match any of the filter or search criteria rather than all of them. Defaults to false.

startSearch.name: StartSearch
startSearch.summary: If true, the search criteria match only at the beginning of a property value instead of anywhere in it. Ignored when wildcards are enabled.

dhostid.summary: ID of the discovered host that runs the service.

dcheckid.name: NetworkDiscoveryCheckId
dcheckid.summary: ID of the discovery check that detected the service.

value.name: Value
value.summary: Value the service returned to a Zabbix agent or SNMP discovery check.

port.name: Port
port.summary: Port number of the service.

status.name: Status
status.summary: Whether the discovered service is up (<c>DSVC_STATUS_ACTIVE</c>) or down (<c>DSVC_STATUS_DISABLED</c>).

lastup.name: LastUp
lastup.summary: Unix time when the service was last found up.

lastdown.name: LastDown
lastdown.summary: Unix time when the service was last found down.

ip.name: Ip
ip.summary: IP address of the host that runs the service.

dns.name: Dns
dns.summary: DNS name of the host that runs the service.

DiscoveredServiceGetParameters.summary: Query parameters for the discovered service .get API method.

dserviceids.name: DiscoveredServiceIds
dserviceids.summary: Limits the result to the discovered services whose IDs are listed.

dhostids.name: DiscoveredHostIds
dhostids.summary: Keeps discovered services found on any of the listed discovered hosts.

druleids.name: NetworkDiscoveryRuleIds
druleids.summary: Keeps discovered services found by any of the listed discovery rules.

output.name: Output
output.summary: Properties of the discovered services to return: a list of property names, or extend for all properties.

filter.name: Filter
filter.summary: Return only discovered services whose properties exactly match the given values; each key is a property name and each value is a single value or an array of accepted values.

search.name: Search
search.summary: Return only discovered services whose properties contain the given text; matching is case-insensitive and substring-based unless startSearch or searchWildcardsEnabled changes it.

searchWildcardsEnabled.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
searchWildcardsEnabled.summary: When true, an asterisk in a search value matches any sequence of characters.

searchByAny.name: SearchByAny
searchByAny.summary: When true, return objects that match any of the search criteria instead of all of them.

startSearch.name: StartSearch
startSearch.summary: When true, search values match only at the beginning of a property instead of anywhere in it.

excludeSearch.name: ExcludeSearch
excludeSearch.summary: When true, return the objects that do not match the search criteria.

limit.name: Limit
limit.summary: Maximum number of records to return.

sortfield.name: SortField
sortfield.summary: Properties to sort the result by; supported values are dserviceid, dhostid and ip.

sortorder.name: SortOrder
sortorder.summary: Sort direction for each sort field: ASC for ascending (the default) or DESC for descending.

countOutput.name: CountOutput
countOutput.summary: When true, return the number of matching discovered services instead of the records themselves.

editable.name: Editable
editable.summary: When true, return only discovered services that the user has write permission on.

preservekeys.name: PreserveKeys
preservekeys.summary: When true, return the result as an object keyed by ID instead of an array.

dcheckids.summary: Limits the result to discovered services found by any of the listed checks.

groupCount.summary: When used with countOutput, return one count for each related object the query is filtered by (for example, one per host) instead of a single total.

limitSelects.summary: Maximum number of records returned by the selectHosts subselect.

selectDHosts.summary: Adds the discovered hosts that own the service under `dhosts`.

selectDRules.summary: Adds the discovery rules that found the service under `drules`.
selectDRules.name: SelectNetworkDiscoveryRules

selectHosts.summary: Adds, under `hosts`, the hosts sharing the service's IP address and proxy. Supports count.

DiscoveryRule.summary: The discovery rule read model, as returned by the Zabbix API.

itemid.name: ItemId
itemid.summary: ID of the discovery rule.

hostid.name: HostId
hostid.summary: The host or template that owns the discovery rule, by ID.

name.name: Name
name.summary: The discovery rule's visible label.

key_.name: Key
key_.summary: Item key of the discovery rule; it must be unique on the host or template.

type.name: Type
type.summary: How the server collects the discovery data, for example Zabbix agent, SNMP agent, HTTP agent, script or dependent item.

delay.name: Delay
delay.summary: Update interval, as a time unit with a suffix (30s, 1m) or a user macro, optionally followed by custom flexible and scheduling intervals separated by semicolons.

status.name: Status
status.summary: Controls whether the rule is active. Disabled rules are skipped.

state.name: State
state.summary: Whether the server can process the discovery rule: normal or not supported.

description.name: Description
description.summary: Description of the discovery rule.

error.name: Error
error.summary: Why the server could not process the discovery rule; empty while it is supported.

lifetime.name: Lifetime
lifetime.summary: How long entities that are no longer discovered are kept before deletion, as a time unit of 0 or from 1 hour to 25 years with user macros allowed; used only when entities are deleted after the lifetime period. Defaults to 7d.

enabled_lifetime.name: EnabledLifetime
enabled_lifetime.summary: How long entities that are no longer discovered stay enabled before they are disabled, as a time unit of 0 or from 1 hour to 25 years with user macros allowed; used only when they are disabled after the period, and must be shorter than Lifetime.

interfaceid.name: InterfaceId
interfaceid.summary: ID of the host interface the discovery rule is polled through; 0 for a type that uses no interface.

templateid.name: TemplateId
templateid.summary: ID of the discovery rule in the template it was inherited from; 0 when it was not inherited.

snmp_oid.name: SnmpOid
snmp_oid.summary: SNMP OID or SNMP request that SNMP agent rules query; required for that type.

master_itemid.name: MasterItemId
master_itemid.summary: ID of the master item whose value a dependent discovery rule processes; required for dependent rules.

flags.name: Flags
flags.summary: What low-level discovery made of the discovery rule: a plain discovery rule, a discovery rule or prototype, or one created by discovery.

uuid.name: Uuid
uuid.summary: Universally unique identifier of the discovery rule, which matches it to the same discovery rule when a configuration is exported and imported.

url.name: Url
url.summary: URL that HTTP agent rules request; required for that type.

allow_traps.name: AllowTraps
allow_traps.summary: Whether an HTTP agent rule also accepts data sent to it as a trapper. Defaults to false.

authtype.name: AuthType
authtype.summary: Authentication method. For SSH agent rules: 0 password, 1 public key. For HTTP agent rules: 0 none, 1 basic, 2 NTLM, 3 Kerberos, 4 Digest. Defaults to 0.

follow_redirects.name: FollowRedirects
follow_redirects.summary: Whether HTTP agent rules follow HTTP redirects. Defaults to true.

headers.name: Headers
headers.summary: HTTP headers, as name and value pairs, that HTTP agent rules send with the request.

http_proxy.name: HttpProxy
http_proxy.summary: HTTP proxy that HTTP agent rules connect through, in the form [protocol://][user[:password]@]host[:port].

ipmi_sensor.name: IpmiSensor
ipmi_sensor.summary: IPMI sensor that IPMI agent rules read.

jmx_endpoint.name: JmxEndpoint
jmx_endpoint.summary: JMX endpoint URL that JMX agent rules connect to; defaults to service:jmx:rmi:///jndi/rmi://{HOST.CONN}:{HOST.PORT}/jmxrmi.

lifetime_type.name: LifetimeType
lifetime_type.summary: What happens to discovered entities that the rule no longer finds: deleted after the lifetime period, never deleted, or deleted immediately. Defaults to deleting after the lifetime period.

enabled_lifetime_type.name: EnabledLifetimeType
enabled_lifetime_type.summary: What happens to entities that are no longer discovered while they await deletion: disabled after the enabled lifetime period, never disabled, or disabled immediately. Not used when entities are deleted immediately; defaults to disabling immediately.

output_format.name: OutputFormat
output_format.summary: How HTTP agent rules store the response: as received, or converted to JSON. Defaults to as received.

params.name: Params
params.summary: Parameters of the item type: the formula of a calculated item, the SQL query of a database monitor item, the script of an SSH, Telnet or script item.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.summary: Parameters, as name and value pairs, passed to the script of script and browser rules.

password.name: Password
password.summary: Password for authentication, used by SSH agent, Telnet agent, database monitor, JMX agent and HTTP agent rules.

post_type.name: PostType
post_type.summary: Format of the request body that HTTP agent rules send: raw data, JSON or XML. Defaults to raw data.

posts.name: Posts
posts.summary: Request body that HTTP agent rules send; required when the body type is JSON or XML.

privatekey.name: PrivateKey
privatekey.summary: Name of the private key file used by SSH agent rules with public key authentication.

publickey.name: PublicKey
publickey.summary: Name of the public key file used by SSH agent rules with public key authentication.

query_fields.name: QueryFields
query_fields.summary: Query parameters, as name and value pairs, that HTTP agent rules append to the URL.

request_method.name: RequestMethod
request_method.summary: HTTP method that HTTP agent rules use: GET, POST, PUT or HEAD. Defaults to GET.

retrieve_mode.name: RetrieveMode
retrieve_mode.summary: Which part of the HTTP response HTTP agent rules store: the body, the headers, or both. HEAD requests can store only the headers. Defaults to the body.

ssl_cert_file.name: SslCertFile
ssl_cert_file.summary: Path to the public SSL key file that HTTP agent rules use for client authentication.

ssl_key_file.name: SslKeyFile
ssl_key_file.summary: Path to the private SSL key file that HTTP agent rules use for client authentication.

ssl_key_password.name: SslKeyPassword
ssl_key_password.summary: Password for the private SSL key file used by HTTP agent rules.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.summary: Timeout for collecting the data, as a time unit from 1 to 600 seconds with user macros allowed; empty uses the proxy or global timeout for the rule type.

trapper_hosts.name: TrapperHosts
trapper_hosts.summary: Comma-separated IP addresses, CIDR ranges or DNS names allowed to send data to Zabbix trapper rules and HTTP agent rules that accept traps; empty accepts any sender.

username.name: Username
username.summary: User name for authentication, used by SSH agent, Telnet agent, database monitor, JMX agent and HTTP agent rules.

verify_host.name: VerifyHost
verify_host.summary: Whether HTTP agent rules verify that the host name in the URL matches the server certificate. Defaults to false.

verify_peer.name: VerifyPeer
verify_peer.summary: Whether HTTP agent rules verify the certificate of the web server. Defaults to false.

filter.name: Filter
filter.summary: Filter that discovered rows must pass, with its conditions and evaluation method; returned when selectFilter is requested.

preprocessing.name: Preprocessing
preprocessing.summary: Preprocessing steps applied to the discovery data; returned when selectPreprocessing is requested.

lld_macro_paths.name: LldMacroPaths
lld_macro_paths.summary: LLD macros and the JSONPath expressions that extract their values from the discovered data; returned when selectLLDMacroPaths is requested.

overrides.name: Overrides
overrides.summary: Overrides that change the attributes of discovered entities that match their filters; returned when selectOverrides is requested.

status_codes.summary: HTTP status codes that HTTP agent rules accept as success, as a comma-separated list of codes and ranges with user macros allowed. Defaults to 200.

username.summary: User name for authentication, used by SSH agent, Telnet agent, database monitor, JMX agent and HTTP agent rules.

DiscoveryRuleGetParameters.summary: Query parameters for the discovery rule .get API method.

itemids.name: ItemIds
itemids.summary: Limits the result to the discovery rules whose IDs are listed.

hostids.name: HostIds
hostids.summary: Keeps discovery rules defined on any of the listed hosts or templates.

groupids.name: GroupIds
groupids.summary: Keeps discovery rules owned by a host or template that is a member of any listed host or template group.

templateids.name: TemplateIds
templateids.summary: Keeps discovery rules owned by any of the listed templates.

interfaceids.name: InterfaceIds
interfaceids.summary: Return only discovery rules that use the given host interfaces.

monitored.name: Monitored
monitored.summary: When true, return only enabled discovery rules on monitored hosts; when false, only rules that are disabled or on unmonitored hosts.

inherited.name: Inherited
inherited.summary: When true, return only discovery rules inherited from a template; when false, only rules that are not inherited.

templated.name: Templated
templated.summary: When true, return only discovery rules that belong to templates; when false, only rules on hosts.

limitSelects.name: LimitSelects
limitSelects.summary: Maximum number of records returned by each related-object select parameter.

selectFilter.name: SelectFilter
selectFilter.summary: Return the filter of the rule in the filter property.

selectHosts.name: SelectHosts
selectHosts.summary: Return the host or template the rule belongs to in the hosts property.

selectPreprocessing.name: SelectPreprocessing
selectPreprocessing.summary: Return the preprocessing steps of the rule in the preprocessing property.

selectLLDMacroPaths.name: SelectLldMacroPaths
selectLLDMacroPaths.summary: Return the LLD macro paths of the rule in the lld_macro_paths property.

selectOverrides.name: SelectOverrides
selectOverrides.summary: Return the overrides of the rule in the overrides property.

selectDiscoveryData.name: SelectDiscoveryData
selectDiscoveryData.summary: Return the discovery data of a rule created from a discovery rule prototype, such as the parent prototype and the deletion and disabling schedule, in the discoveryData property.

selectDiscoveryRulePrototypes.name: SelectDiscoveryRulePrototypes
selectDiscoveryRulePrototypes.summary: Return the discovery rule prototypes of the rule in the discoveryRulePrototypes property; supports count.

selectGraphs.name: SelectGraphs
selectGraphs.summary: Return the graph prototypes of the rule in the graphs property.

selectHostPrototypes.name: SelectHostPrototypes
selectHostPrototypes.summary: Return the host prototypes of the rule in the hostPrototypes property.

selectItems.name: SelectItems
selectItems.summary: Return the item prototypes of the rule in the items property.

selectTriggers.name: SelectTriggers
selectTriggers.summary: Return the trigger prototypes of the rule in the triggers property.

output.name: Output
output.summary: Properties to return for each result; when omitted, all properties are returned.

filter.name: Filter
filter.summary: Return only results whose properties exactly match the given values; each key is a property name and each value is a single value or an array of accepted values.

search.name: Search
search.summary: Return only results whose given text properties contain the given strings; matching is case-insensitive.

searchWildcardsEnabled.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
searchWildcardsEnabled.summary: When true, an asterisk in a Search value matches any sequence of characters.

searchByAny.name: SearchByAny
searchByAny.summary: When true, return results that match any of the Filter or Search criteria instead of all of them.

startSearch.name: StartSearch
startSearch.summary: When true, the Search values must match the start of the property rather than any part of it.

excludeSearch.name: ExcludeSearch
excludeSearch.summary: When true, return results that do not match the Search criteria.

limit.name: Limit
limit.summary: Maximum number of records to return.

sortfield.name: SortField
sortfield.summary: Properties to sort the results by; only the properties this method supports for sorting are accepted.

sortorder.name: SortOrder

countOutput.name: CountOutput

editable.name: Editable
editable.summary: When true, return only objects the calling user has write permission to.

preservekeys.name: PreserveKeys
preservekeys.summary: When true, return the results as an object keyed by ID instead of an array.

groupCount.summary: When true together with CountOutput, return a separate count for each value of the ID filter in use instead of a single total.

selectDiscoveryRule.summary: Return the parent discovery rule that created this rule from a discovery rule prototype in the discoveryRule property.

DiscoveryRulePrototype.summary: The discovery rule prototype read model, as returned by the Zabbix API.

itemid.name: ItemId
itemid.summary: ID of the discovery rule prototype.

hostid.name: HostId
hostid.summary: The host or template that owns the discovery rule prototype, by ID.

name.name: Name
name.summary: LLD rule prototype name.

uuid.name: Uuid
uuid.summary: Universally unique identifier of the discovery rule prototype, which matches it to the same discovery rule prototype when a configuration is exported and imported.

flags.name: Flags
flags.summary: What low-level discovery made of the discovery rule prototype: a plain discovery rule prototype, a discovery rule or prototype, or one created by discovery.

key_.name: Key
key_.summary: Key of the LLD rule prototype; it must contain at least one LLD macro.

type.name: Type
type.summary: How the LLD rule prototype collects its data, such as Zabbix agent, SNMP agent, HTTP agent, script, dependent item or nested discovery.

delay.name: Delay
delay.summary: Update interval, as a time unit with a suffix (30s, 1m) or a user macro, optionally followed by custom flexible and scheduling intervals separated by semicolons.

status.name: Status
status.summary: Whether the LLD rule prototype is enabled or disabled.

description.name: Description
description.summary: Free-form text describing this LLD rule prototype.

templateid.name: TemplateId
templateid.summary: ID of the discovery rule prototype in the template it was inherited from; 0 when it was not inherited.

discover.name: Discover
discover.summary: Whether new discovery rules are created from this prototype (default ).

snmp_oid.name: SnmpOid
snmp_oid.summary: SNMP OID to query; required when the type is SNMP agent.

master_itemid.name: MasterItemId
master_itemid.summary: ID of the master item whose value a dependent LLD rule prototype processes; required when the type is dependent item.

interfaceid.name: InterfaceId
interfaceid.summary: ID of the host interface the discovery rule prototype is polled through; 0 for a type that uses no interface.

lifetime_type.name: LifetimeType
lifetime_type.summary: What happens to discovered resources that are no longer found: deleted once the lifetime has elapsed (the default), never deleted, or deleted immediately.

lifetime.name: Lifetime
lifetime.summary: How long a resource that is no longer discovered is kept before it is deleted, as seconds, a time suffix value or a user macro, between 1 hour and 25 years (or 0); used when the lifetime type deletes after a period. Defaults to 7d.

enabled_lifetime_type.name: EnabledLifetimeType
enabled_lifetime_type.summary: What happens to discovered resources that are no longer found before they are deleted: disabled once the enabled lifetime has elapsed, never disabled, or disabled immediately (the default).

enabled_lifetime.name: EnabledLifetime
enabled_lifetime.summary: How long a resource that is no longer discovered stays enabled before it is disabled, as seconds, a time suffix value or a user macro, between 1 hour and 25 years (or 0); used when the enabled lifetime type disables after a period.

trapper_hosts.name: TrapperHosts
trapper_hosts.summary: Hosts allowed to send values, as a comma-separated list of addresses, DNS names or user macros; applies to trapper rules and to HTTP agent rules that allow traps. When omitted the server uses the {$TRAPPER.ALLOWED_HOSTS} macro, and an empty string denies all hosts.

params.name: Params
params.summary: Parameters of the item type: the formula of a calculated item, the SQL query of a database monitor item, the script of an SSH, Telnet or script item.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.summary: Name and value pairs passed to the script of a Script or Browser rule; names must be unique.

ipmi_sensor.name: IpmiSensor
ipmi_sensor.summary: IPMI sensor to read; required for IPMI agent rules unless the key is ipmi.get.

jmx_endpoint.name: JmxEndpoint
jmx_endpoint.summary: Custom JMX connection string for JMX agent rules; defaults to service:jmx:rmi:///jndi/rmi://{HOST.CONN}:{HOST.PORT}/jmxrmi.

authtype.name: AuthType
authtype.summary: Authentication method, which depends on the type. For SSH agent rules: 0 for password, 1 for public key. For HTTP agent rules: 0 for none, 1 for basic, 2 for NTLM, 3 for Kerberos, 4 for Digest.

username.name: Username
username.summary: User name for authentication; required for SSH and TELNET agent rules and used by simple check, database monitor, JMX agent and HTTP agent rules.

password.name: Password
password.summary: Password for authentication; used by simple check, database monitor, SSH, TELNET, JMX agent and HTTP agent rules.

publickey.name: PublicKey
publickey.summary: Public key file name; SSH agent rules using public key authentication must set it.

privatekey.name: PrivateKey
privatekey.summary: Private key file name; SSH agent rules that authenticate with a public key must set it.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.summary: Timeout for the data collection request, as seconds or a time suffix value between 1s and 600s, or a user macro; an empty string uses the proxy or global setting.

url.name: Url
url.summary: URL to request for HTTP agent rules; supports user macros and host and item macros such as {HOST.CONN} and {ITEM.KEY}.

query_fields.name: QueryFields
query_fields.summary: Name and value pairs appended to the URL as query parameters by HTTP agent rules.

posts.name: Posts
posts.summary: Request body sent by HTTP agent rules; required when the post type is JSON or XML.

post_type.name: PostType
post_type.summary: Format of the request body in posts for HTTP agent rules: raw data (the default), JSON or XML.

status_codes.name: StatusCodes
status_codes.summary: Comma-separated HTTP status codes or ranges that count as success for HTTP agent rules, for example 200,200-{$M}; user macros are allowed. Defaults to 200.

follow_redirects.name: FollowRedirects
follow_redirects.summary: Whether HTTP agent rules follow HTTP redirects; enabled by default.

http_proxy.name: HttpProxy
http_proxy.summary: HTTP or HTTPS proxy connection string used by HTTP agent rules.

headers.name: Headers
headers.summary: HTTP headers sent with each request by HTTP agent rules, as name and value pairs.

retrieve_mode.name: RetrieveMode
retrieve_mode.summary: Which part of the HTTP response an HTTP agent rule keeps: the body (the default), the headers, or both; a HEAD request can keep only the headers.

request_method.name: RequestMethod
request_method.summary: HTTP method used by HTTP agent rules: GET (the default), POST, PUT or HEAD.

output_format.name: OutputFormat
output_format.summary: Whether an HTTP agent rule stores the response as received (the default) or converts it to JSON.

ssl_cert_file.name: SslCertFile
ssl_cert_file.summary: Path of the public SSL certificate file used for client authentication by HTTP agent rules.

ssl_key_file.name: SslKeyFile
ssl_key_file.summary: Path of the private SSL key file used for client authentication by HTTP agent rules.

ssl_key_password.name: SslKeyPassword
ssl_key_password.summary: Password of the SSL private key file used by HTTP agent rules.

verify_peer.name: VerifyPeer
verify_peer.summary: Whether HTTP agent rules validate that the server certificate is authentic; off by default.

verify_host.name: VerifyHost
verify_host.summary: Whether HTTP agent rules validate that the host name matches the server certificate; off by default.

allow_traps.name: AllowTraps
allow_traps.summary: Whether an HTTP agent rule also accepts values pushed to it as a trapper would; off by default.

filter.name: Filter
filter.summary: Filter that decides which discovered entries the rule prototype processes, made of LLD macro conditions and an evaluation method; returned when selectFilter is requested.

lld_macro_paths.name: LldMacroPaths
lld_macro_paths.summary: LLD macros mapped to the JSONPath or selector that extracts each macro value from the discovered data.

overrides.name: Overrides
overrides.summary: Overrides that change prototype objects for discovered entries that match each override filter, in evaluation order.

preprocessing.name: Preprocessing
preprocessing.summary: Preprocessing steps applied to the discovered data before it is processed, in execution order.

DiscoveryRulePrototypeGetParameters.summary: Query parameters for the discovery rule prototype .get API method.

itemids.summary: Limits the result to the LLD rule prototypes whose IDs are listed.

hostids.name: HostIds
hostids.summary: Keeps LLD rule prototypes owned by any of the listed hosts or templates.

discoveryids.name: DiscoveryIds
discoveryids.summary: Keeps LLD rule prototypes whose parent is one of the listed LLD rules or LLD rule prototypes.

templateids.name: TemplateIds
templateids.summary: Keeps LLD rule prototypes defined on any of the listed templates.

output.name: Output
output.summary: Properties of the LLD rule prototypes to return: a list of property names, or extend for all properties.

filter.name: Filter
filter.summary: Return only LLD rule prototypes whose properties exactly match the given values; each key is a property name and each value is a single value or an array of accepted values. The additional key host matches the technical name of the owning host.

search.name: Search
search.summary: Return only LLD rule prototypes whose properties contain the given text; matching is case-insensitive and substring-based unless startSearch or searchWildcardsEnabled changes it.

searchWildcardsEnabled.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
searchWildcardsEnabled.summary: When true, an asterisk in a search value matches any sequence of characters.

searchByAny.name: SearchByAny
searchByAny.summary: When true, return objects that match any of the search criteria instead of all of them.

startSearch.name: StartSearch
startSearch.summary: When true, search values match only at the beginning of a property instead of anywhere in it.

excludeSearch.name: ExcludeSearch
excludeSearch.summary: When true, return the objects that do not match the search criteria.

limit.name: Limit
limit.summary: Maximum number of records to return.

sortfield.name: SortField
sortfield.summary: Properties to sort the result by; supported values are itemid, name, key_, delay, type and status.

sortorder.name: SortOrder
sortorder.summary: Sort direction for each sort field: ASC for ascending (the default) or DESC for descending.

countOutput.name: CountOutput
countOutput.summary: When true, return the number of matching LLD rule prototypes instead of the records themselves.

editable.name: Editable
editable.summary: When true, return only LLD rule prototypes that the user has write permission on.

preservekeys.name: PreserveKeys
preservekeys.summary: When true, return the result as an object keyed by ID instead of an array.

groupCount.summary: When used with countOutput, return one count for each related object the query is filtered by (for example, one per host) instead of a single total.

groupids.summary: Return only LLD rule prototypes on hosts that belong to the given host groups.

inherited.summary: When true, return only LLD rule prototypes inherited from a template; when false, only those that are not inherited.

interfaceids.summary: Keeps LLD rule prototypes bound to any of the listed host interfaces.

limitSelects.summary: Maximum number of records returned by the selectItems, selectGraphs and selectTriggers subselects.

monitored.summary: When true, return only enabled LLD rule prototypes on monitored hosts; when false, only the others.

selectDiscoveryData.summary: Return a discoveryData property with the low-level discovery details of a discovered LLD rule prototype, such as its parent prototype, discovery status and scheduled deletion and disabling times.

selectDiscoveryRule.summary: Return a discoveryRule property with the parent LLD rule; it is empty when the parent is itself an LLD rule prototype.

selectDiscoveryRulePrototype.summary: Return a discoveryRulePrototype property with the parent LLD rule prototype; it is empty when the parent is an LLD rule.

selectDiscoveryRulePrototypes.summary: Return a discoveryRulePrototypes property with the child LLD rule prototypes of each prototype; supports count.

selectFilter.summary: Return a filter property with the filter of the LLD rule prototype.

selectGraphs.summary: Return a graphs property with the graph prototypes of the LLD rule prototype; supports count.

selectHostPrototypes.summary: Return a hostPrototypes property with the host prototypes of the LLD rule prototype; supports count.

selectHosts.summary: Return a hosts property with the host or template that the LLD rule prototype belongs to.

selectItems.summary: Return an items property with the item prototypes of the LLD rule prototype; supports count.

selectLLDMacroPaths.summary: Return an lld_macro_paths property with the LLD macros and the paths that supply their values.
selectLLDMacroPaths.name: SelectLldMacroPaths

selectOverrides.summary: Return an overrides property with the override filters, conditions and operations applied to prototype objects.

selectPreprocessing.summary: Return a preprocessing property with the preprocessing steps of the LLD rule prototype.

selectTriggers.summary: Return a triggers property with the trigger prototypes of the LLD rule prototype; supports count.

templated.summary: When true, return only LLD rule prototypes that belong to templates; when false, only those on hosts.

Event.summary: The event read model, as returned by the Zabbix API.

source.name: Source
source.summary: What created the event: a trigger, network discovery, active agent autoregistration, an internal state change, or a service status update.

object.name: ObjectType
object.summary: Type of object the event is related to (<c>EVENT_OBJECT_*</c>).

objectid.name: ObjectId
objectid.summary: ID of the object that created the event; the kind of object depends on the event source.

clock.name: Clock
clock.summary: Time the event was created, as a Unix timestamp.

ns.name: Ns
ns.summary: Nanoseconds of the time the event was created.

value.name: Value
value.summary: State the event records, which depends on the source: OK or problem for trigger and service events; up, down, discovered or lost for discovery events; normal or unknown/not supported for internal events.

name.name: Name
name.summary: Resolved name of the event.

severity.name: Severity
severity.summary: Current severity of the event, from not classified to disaster.

r_eventid.name: RecoveryEventId
r_eventid.summary: ID of the recovery event that resolved this problem event.

c_eventid.name: ClosingEventId
c_eventid.summary: ID of the event that closed this problem under a global correlation rule; set only when a correlation rule closed it.

cause_eventid.name: CauseEventId
cause_eventid.summary: ID of the cause event, when this event is a symptom of another event.

correlationid.name: CorrelationId
correlationid.summary: ID of the global correlation rule that closed the problem; set only when a correlation rule closed it.

userid.name: UserId
userid.summary: For a manually closed problem, the closing user, by ID.

suppressed.name: Suppressed
suppressed.summary: Indicates suppression of the event, either manual or through maintenance.

opdata.name: Opdata
opdata.summary: Operational data of the event with macros expanded.

urls.name: Urls
urls.summary: Names and URLs defined by active media types with an enabled event menu entry, with macros expanded.

acknowledges.name: Acknowledges
acknowledges.summary: Updates made to the event, such as acknowledgements, messages, severity changes and suppression, newest first; returned when selectAcknowledges is requested.

tags.name: Tags
tags.summary: Tags of the event; returned when selectTags is requested.

hosts.name: Hosts
hosts.summary: Hosts that contain the object that created the event; returned when selectHosts is requested.

suppression_data.name: SuppressionData
suppression_data.summary: Maintenance-suppression entries (returned by selectSuppressionData). Previously dropped on read even when EventGetParameters.SelectSuppressionData requested it.

cep_ruleid.summary: ID of the complex event processing rule that closed the problem, when such a rule closed it.

flags.summary: How the server created the event: 0 from its source, 1 as a copy of another event that event processing made (<c>ZBX_EVENT_NORMAL</c>, <c>ZBX_EVENT_COPIED</c> in the server's <c>cep/zbx_cep.h</c>).

userid.name: UserId
userid.summary: ID of the user who made the update.

clock.name: Clock
clock.summary: Time of the update, as a Unix timestamp.

message.name: Message
message.summary: Message text left with the update.

action.name: Action
action.summary: Actions performed by the update, combined as flags, such as close, acknowledge, add message, change severity, suppress or change rank.

old_severity.name: OldSeverity
old_severity.summary: Severity of the event before the update.

new_severity.name: NewSeverity
new_severity.summary: Severity of the event after the update.

suppress_until.name: SuppressUntil
suppress_until.summary: Time until which the update suppresses the event, as a Unix timestamp; 0 means indefinitely.

taskid.name: TaskId
taskid.summary: ID of the server task created to apply the update, if any.

username.name: Username
username.summary: Username of the user who made the update.

name.name: Name
name.summary: First name of the user who made the update.

surname.name: Surname
surname.summary: Last name of the user who made the update.

cep_ruleid.summary: ID of the complex event processing rule that made the update, for updates made by such a rule.

details.summary: JSON description of the changes that complex event processing rules made to the event; empty for other updates.

maintenanceid.summary: ID of the maintenance that suppressed or unsuppressed the event, for updates made by maintenance.

EventGetParameters.summary: Query parameters for the event .get API method.

eventids.name: EventIds
eventids.summary: Limits the result to the events whose IDs are listed.

hostids.name: HostIds
hostids.summary: Return only events created by objects on the given hosts.

groupids.name: GroupIds
groupids.summary: Return only events created by objects on hosts in the given host groups.

objectids.name: ObjectIds
objectids.summary: Keeps events whose source is one of the listed objects.

source.name: Source
source.summary: Return only events from the given source; defaults to trigger events.

object.name: ObjectType
object.summary: Return only events of this type of object.

acknowledged.name: Acknowledged
acknowledged.summary: When true, return only acknowledged events; when false, only unacknowledged ones.

suppressed.name: Suppressed
suppressed.summary: When true, return only suppressed events; when false, only events that are not suppressed.

symptom.name: Symptom
symptom.summary: When true, return only symptom events; when false, only cause events.

action.name: Action
action.summary: Return only events with an update that performed all of the given update actions, combined as flags.

action_userids.name: ActionUserIds
action_userids.summary: Return only events updated by the given users.

severities.name: Severities
severities.summary: Keeps events whose severity is in the list; trigger events only.

time_from.name: TimeFrom
time_from.summary: Keeps events whose creation time is no earlier than this Unix time.

time_till.name: TimeTo
time_till.summary: Keeps events whose creation time is no later than the given Unix time.

trigger_severities.name: TriggerSeverities
trigger_severities.summary: Return only events whose trigger has one of the given severities; applies to trigger events.

evaltype.name: EvalType
evaltype.summary: How the tag conditions combine: And/Or (the default), where conditions on the same tag name are joined with Or and different names with And, or Or, where any condition is enough.

value.name: Value
value.summary: Keeps events whose value is in the list; what each value means varies by event source.

eventid_from.name: EventIdFrom
eventid_from.summary: Return only events whose ID is greater than or equal to the given ID.

eventid_till.name: EventIdTo
eventid_till.summary: Return only events whose ID is less than or equal to the given ID.

problem_time_from.name: ProblemTimeFrom
problem_time_from.summary: Return only events that were in the problem state at some point from the given Unix time on, regardless of their current state; applies to trigger events and requires problem_time_till.

problem_time_till.name: ProblemTimeTo
problem_time_till.summary: Return only events that were in the problem state at some point up to the given Unix time, regardless of their current state; applies to trigger events and requires problem_time_from.

selectAcknowledges.name: SelectAcknowledges
selectAcknowledges.summary: Return an acknowledges property with the updates made to the event, newest first; supports count.

selectTags.name: SelectTags
selectTags.summary: Return a tags property with the tags of the event.

selectHosts.name: SelectHosts
selectHosts.summary: Adds, under `hosts`, the hosts holding the event's source object. Works for trigger, item and LLD rule events.

selectSuppressionData.name: SelectSuppressionData
selectSuppressionData.summary: Return a suppression_data property with the active maintenances and manual suppressions of the event.

selectAlerts.name: SelectAlerts
selectAlerts.summary: Adds the alerts the event produced under `alerts`, newest first.

selectRelatedObject.name: SelectRelatedObject
selectRelatedObject.summary: Adds the event's originating object under `relatedObject`. The event source determines what kind of object it is.

tags.name: Tags
tags.summary: Filters events by tag conditions; each one pairs a tag name and value with an operator (contains, equals, does not contain, does not equal, exists or does not exist). With an empty list, no event is filtered out.

output.name: Output
output.summary: Properties of the events to return: a list of property names, or extend for all properties.

filter.name: Filter
filter.summary: Return only events whose properties exactly match the given values; each key is a property name and each value is a single value or an array of accepted values.

search.name: Search
search.summary: Return only events whose properties contain the given text; matching is case-insensitive and substring-based unless startSearch or searchWildcardsEnabled changes it.

searchWildcardsEnabled.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
searchWildcardsEnabled.summary: When true, an asterisk in a search value matches any sequence of characters.

searchByAny.name: SearchByAny
searchByAny.summary: When true, return objects that match any of the search criteria instead of all of them.

startSearch.name: StartSearch
startSearch.summary: When true, search values match only at the beginning of a property instead of anywhere in it.

excludeSearch.name: ExcludeSearch
excludeSearch.summary: When true, return the objects that do not match the search criteria.

limit.name: Limit
limit.summary: Maximum number of records to return.

sortfield.name: SortField
sortfield.summary: Properties to sort the result by; supported values are eventid, objectid and clock; with groupBy only objectid, and with countOutput and groupBy objectid and rowscount.

sortorder.name: SortOrder
sortorder.summary: Sort direction for each sort field: ASC for ascending (the default) or DESC for descending.

countOutput.name: CountOutput
countOutput.summary: When true, return the number of matching events instead of the records themselves.

editable.name: Editable
editable.summary: When true, return only events that the user has write permission on.

preservekeys.name: PreserveKeys
preservekeys.summary: When true, return the result as an object keyed by ID instead of an array.

select_acknowledges.name: SelectAcknowledgesAlias
select_acknowledges.summary: The 7.0 spelling of <c>selectAcknowledges</c> (<see cref="SelectAcknowledges"/>): the same selection, deprecated in 7.0 (<c>API_DEPRECATED</c>) and refused from 7.4 (<c>CEvent.php</c>).

select_alerts.name: SelectAlertsAlias
select_alerts.summary: The 7.0 spelling of <c>selectAlerts</c> (<see cref="SelectAlerts"/>): the same selection, deprecated in 7.0 (<c>API_DEPRECATED</c>) and refused from 7.4 (<c>CEvent.php</c>).

groupBy.summary: Properties to group the result by, which are then returned in each row; objectid is the only supported value.

url.name: Url
url.summary: The address that the link opens, with macros resolved.

name.name: Name
name.summary: The label of the link.

Graph.summary: The graph read model, as returned by the Zabbix API.

name.name: Name
name.summary: Name of the graph.

width.name: Width
width.summary: Graph width, in pixels; 900 unless set.

height.name: Height
height.summary: Graph height, in pixels; 200 unless set.

yaxismin.name: YAxisMin
yaxismin.summary: Fixed minimum of the Y axis, used when <c>ymin_type</c> is fixed.

yaxismax.name: YAxisMax
yaxismax.summary: Fixed maximum of the Y axis, used when <c>ymax_type</c> is fixed.

graphtype.name: GraphType
graphtype.summary: How the graph is drawn: normal, stacked, pie or exploded. Defaults to normal.

show_legend.name: ShowLegend
show_legend.summary: Whether the graph shows a legend: 0 no, 1 yes. Defaults to 1.

show_work_period.name: ShowWorkPeriod
show_work_period.summary: Whether the graph highlights the working time: 0 no, 1 yes. Defaults to 1.

show_triggers.name: ShowTriggers
show_triggers.summary: Whether the graph shows simple trigger thresholds as lines: 0 no, 1 yes. Defaults to 1.

flags.name: Flags
flags.summary: What low-level discovery made of the graph: a plain graph, a discovery rule or prototype, or one created by discovery.

templateid.name: TemplateId
templateid.summary: ID of the graph in the template it was inherited from; 0 when it was not inherited.

gitems.name: GraphItems
gitems.summary: Items drawn on the graph with their display settings; returned when selectGraphItems is requested.

percent_left.summary: Percentile line drawn for the left Y axis of a normal graph, as a percentage; 0 draws none.

percent_right.summary: Percentile line drawn for the right Y axis of a normal graph, as a percentage; 0 draws none.

show_3d.summary: Whether a pie or exploded graph is drawn in 3D: 0 no, 1 yes. Defaults to 0.

uuid.summary: Universal unique identifier that links the graph to its template across exports and imports; used only on templates and generated when omitted.

ymax_itemid.summary: ID of the item whose value sets the maximum of the Y axis when the maximum type is item value.

ymax_type.summary: How the maximum of the Y axis is set: 0 calculated, 1 fixed value, 2 value of the item given in YmaxItemId. Defaults to 0.

ymin_itemid.summary: ID of the item whose value sets the minimum of the Y axis when the minimum type is item value.

ymin_type.summary: How the minimum of the Y axis is set: 0 calculated, 1 fixed value, 2 value of the item given in YminItemId. Defaults to 0.

width.name: Width

ymax_type.name: YMaxType

yaxismin.name: YAxisMin
yaxismin.summary: Fixed minimum of the Y axis, used when <c>ymin_type</c> is fixed.

yaxismax.name: YAxisMax
yaxismax.summary: Fixed maximum of the Y axis, used when <c>ymax_type</c> is fixed.

percent_left.summary: Percentile line drawn for the left Y axis of a normal graph, as a percentage; 0 draws none.

percent_right.summary: Percentile line drawn for the right Y axis of a normal graph, as a percentage; 0 draws none.

show_3d.summary: Whether a pie or exploded graph is drawn in 3D: 0 no, 1 yes. Defaults to 0.

uuid.summary: Universal unique identifier that links the graph to its template across exports and imports; used only on templates and generated when omitted.

ymax_itemid.summary: ID of the item whose value sets the maximum of the Y axis when the maximum type is item value.

ymin_itemid.summary: ID of the item whose value sets the minimum of the Y axis when the minimum type is item value.

graphids.name: GraphIds

hostids.name: HostIds
hostids.summary: Keeps graphs owned by any of the listed hosts or templates.

groupids.name: GroupIds
groupids.summary: Keeps graphs whose owning hosts or templates are members of any listed host or template group.

templateids.name: TemplateIds
templateids.summary: Keeps graphs owned by any of the listed templates.

itemids.name: ItemIds
itemids.summary: Keeps graphs that plot any of the listed items.

templated.name: Templated
templated.summary: When true, return only graphs that belong to templates; when false, only graphs on hosts.

inherited.name: Inherited
inherited.summary: When true, return only graphs inherited from a template; when false, only graphs that are not inherited.

selectGraphItems.name: SelectGraphItems
selectGraphItems.summary: Return the graph items in the gitems property.

selectHosts.name: SelectHosts
selectHosts.summary: Return the hosts or templates the graph belongs to in the hosts property.

selectTemplates.name: SelectTemplates
selectTemplates.summary: Return the templates the graph belongs to in the templates property.

selectHostGroups.name: SelectHostGroups
selectHostGroups.summary: Return the host groups of the hosts the graph belongs to in the hostgroups property.

selectTemplateGroups.name: SelectTemplateGroups
selectTemplateGroups.summary: Return the template groups of the templates the graph belongs to in the templategroups property.

selectItems.name: SelectItems
selectItems.summary: Return the items used in the graph in the items property.

selectDiscoveryRule.name: SelectDiscoveryRule
selectDiscoveryRule.summary: Return the discovery rule that created the graph in the discoveryRule property.

selectDiscoveryData.name: SelectDiscoveryData
selectDiscoveryData.summary: Return the discovery data of a discovered graph, such as the parent prototype, status and deletion time, in the discoveryData property.

output.name: Output

filter.name: Filter

search.name: Search
search.summary: Return only results whose given text properties contain the given strings; matching is case-insensitive.

searchWildcardsEnabled.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
searchWildcardsEnabled.summary: When true, an asterisk in a Search value matches any sequence of characters.

searchByAny.name: SearchByAny
searchByAny.summary: When true, return results that match any of the Filter or Search criteria instead of all of them.

startSearch.name: StartSearch

excludeSearch.name: ExcludeSearch
excludeSearch.summary: When true, return results that do not match the Search criteria.

limit.name: Limit

sortfield.name: SortField
sortfield.summary: Properties to sort the results by; only the properties this method supports for sorting are accepted.

sortorder.name: SortOrder
sortorder.summary: Sort direction for each sort field, ASC (the default) or DESC.

countOutput.name: CountOutput

preservekeys.name: PreserveKeys

groupCount.summary: When true together with CountOutput, return a separate count for each value of the ID filter in use instead of a single total.

selectGraphDiscovery.summary: Deprecated; returns the discovery data of a discovered graph in the graphDiscovery property. Use SelectDiscoveryData instead.

selectGroups.summary: Deprecated alias that returns the host groups in the groups property; use SelectHostGroups or SelectTemplateGroups instead. Zabbix 7.4 and later no longer support it.

itemid.name: ItemId
itemid.summary: ID of the item the graph draws.

color.name: Color
color.summary: The draw color of the item as a hexadecimal color code.

calc_fnc.name: CalcFunction

drawtype.name: DrawType

sortorder.name: Position
sortorder.summary: Position of the item in the graph's drawing order and legend.

yaxisside.name: YAxisSide

type.name: Type
type.summary: The role of the item in the graph: 0 (the default) a simple item, 2 the graph sum, which only pie and exploded graphs use.

gitemid.summary: The unique identifier of the graph item.

graphid.summary: The identifier of the graph the item is drawn in.

selectGraphs.name: SelectGraphs

output.name: Output

sortfield.name: SortField

sortorder.name: SortOrder

countOutput.name: CountOutput

editable.name: Editable
editable.summary: Whether to return only graph items that the current user is allowed to change.

preservekeys.name: PreserveKeys
preservekeys.summary: Whether the result is keyed by object ID instead of being returned as a plain array.

flags.name: Flags

discover.name: Discover

gitems.name: GraphItems
