groupids.summary: Keeps web scenarios whose hosts are members of any listed host group.

templateids.name: TemplateIds
templateids.summary: Keeps web scenarios defined on any of the listed templates.

monitored.name: Monitored
monitored.summary: When true, return only enabled web scenarios on monitored hosts.

selectHosts.name: SelectHosts
selectHosts.summary: Return a hosts property with the host the web scenario belongs to.

selectSteps.name: SelectSteps
selectSteps.summary: Return a steps property with the scenario steps; supports count.

selectTags.name: SelectTags
selectTags.summary: Return a tags property with the tags of the web scenario.

output.name: Output
output.summary: Properties of the web scenarios to return: a list of property names, or extend for all properties.

filter.name: Filter
filter.summary: Return only web scenarios whose properties exactly match the given values; each key is a property name and each value is a single value or an array of accepted values.

search.name: Search
search.summary: Return only web scenarios whose properties contain the given text; matching is case-insensitive and substring-based unless startSearch or searchWildcardsEnabled changes it.

searchByAny.name: SearchByAny
searchByAny.summary: When true, return objects that match any of the search criteria instead of all of them.

startSearch.name: StartSearch
startSearch.summary: When true, search values match only at the beginning of a property instead of anywhere in it.

excludeSearch.name: ExcludeSearch
excludeSearch.summary: When true, return the objects that do not match the search criteria.

limit.name: Limit
limit.summary: Maximum number of records to return.

sortfield.name: SortField
sortfield.summary: Properties to sort the result by; supported values are httptestid and name.

sortorder.name: SortOrder
sortorder.summary: Sort direction for each sort field: ASC for ascending (the default) or DESC for descending.

countOutput.name: CountOutput
countOutput.summary: When true, return the number of matching web scenarios instead of the records themselves.

editable.name: Editable
editable.summary: When true, return only web scenarios that the user has write permission on.

preservekeys.name: PreserveKeys
preservekeys.summary: When true, return the result as an object keyed by ID instead of an array.

evaltype.summary: How the tag conditions combine: And/Or (the default), where conditions on the same tag name are joined with Or and different names with And, or Or, where any condition is enough.

expandName.summary: When true, macros in the web scenario name are expanded.

expandStepName.summary: Set to true to resolve macros in step names.

groupCount.summary: When used with countOutput, return one count for each related object the query is filtered by (for example, one per host) instead of a single total.

inherited.summary: True keeps only web scenarios inherited from a template; false keeps only those defined directly.

inheritedTags.summary: When true, a web scenario matches the tag conditions only if its template, host or linked templates also carry the tags; by default those tags are ignored.

selectInheritedTags.summary: Return an inheritedTags property with the tags found on the template, host and linked templates.

tags.summary: Filters web scenarios by tag; each condition pairs a tag name and value with an operator (contains, equals, does not contain, does not equal, exists or does not exist). With no conditions, every web scenario matches.

templated.summary: True keeps web scenarios defined on templates; false keeps those defined on hosts.

name.name: Name
name.summary: Name of the scenario step, unique within the web scenario.

url.name: Url
url.summary: URL that the step requests.

no.name: StepNumber
no.summary: Sequence number of the step within the web scenario; steps run in ascending order.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.summary: Request timeout of the step, as a time unit with an optional suffix from 1 second to 1 hour or a user macro; the server uses 15 seconds when omitted.

required.name: Required
required.summary: Text that must be present in the response for the step to succeed; empty when no text is required.

status_codes.name: StatusCodes
status_codes.summary: HTTP status codes accepted as success, as a comma-separated list of codes and ranges such as 200,201,210-299; empty accepts any status code.

follow_redirects.name: FollowRedirects
follow_redirects.summary: Whether HTTP redirects are followed: 0 does not follow them, 1 follows them.

retrieve_mode.name: RetrieveMode
retrieve_mode.summary: Part of the HTTP response the step retrieves: 0 the body, 1 the headers, 2 both.

posts.name: Posts
posts.summary: HTTP POST data sent by the step, as raw data or form fields depending on the post type.

httptestid.summary: ID of the web scenario the step belongs to.

post_type.summary: How the POST data is sent: 0 as raw data, 1 as form fields.

iconmapid.name: IconMapId
iconmapid.summary: The unique identifier of the icon map.

name.name: Name
name.summary: The unique name of the icon map.

default_iconid.name: DefaultIconId
default_iconid.summary: The icon used for hosts that match none of the mappings.

mappings.name: Mappings
mappings.summary: The icon mappings of the icon map; returned when selectMappings is requested.

IconMapCreateRequest.summary: Write-request payload for the icon map .create API method.

name.name: Name
name.summary: The unique name of the icon map; required.

default_iconid.name: DefaultIconId
default_iconid.summary: The icon used for hosts that match none of the mappings; required.

mappings.name: Mappings
mappings.summary: The mappings that pick an icon by matching an expression against a host inventory field. At least one is required.

IconMapGetParameters.summary: Query parameters for the icon map .get API method.

iconmapids.name: IconMapIds
iconmapids.summary: Limits the result to the icon maps whose IDs are listed.

sysmapids.name: MapIds
sysmapids.summary: Return only icon maps used by the given network maps.

selectMappings.name: SelectMappings
selectMappings.summary: Return the icon mappings of the icon map in a mappings property.

output.name: Output
output.summary: Which properties to return for each object, given as a list of property names or extend to return all of them.

filter.name: Filter
filter.summary: Return only icon maps whose properties exactly match the given values; each key is a property name and each value is a single value or an array of accepted values.

search.name: Search
search.summary: Return only icon maps whose properties contain the given strings, using a case-insensitive substring match by default; each key is a property name.

searchWildcardsEnabled.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
searchWildcardsEnabled.summary: Whether an asterisk in a search string acts as a wildcard that matches any sequence of characters.

searchByAny.name: SearchByAny
searchByAny.summary: Whether an object that matches any one of the search or filter criteria is returned; by default every criterion must match.

startSearch.name: StartSearch
startSearch.summary: Whether the search strings must match the beginning of the property value rather than any part of it.

excludeSearch.name: ExcludeSearch
excludeSearch.summary: Whether to return the objects that do not match the search criteria instead of those that do.

limit.name: Limit
limit.summary: The maximum number of icon maps to return.

sortfield.name: SortField
sortfield.summary: The properties to sort the result by; accepted values are iconmapid and name.

sortorder.name: SortOrder
sortorder.summary: The sort direction for each sort field, ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC); ascending when omitted.

countOutput.name: CountOutput
countOutput.summary: Whether to return the number of matching icon maps instead of the icon maps themselves.

editable.name: Editable
editable.summary: Whether to return only icon maps that the current user is allowed to change.

preservekeys.name: PreserveKeys
preservekeys.summary: Whether the result is keyed by object ID instead of being returned as a plain array.

iconid.name: IconId
iconid.summary: ID of the image used as the icon when the mapping matches.

expression.name: Expression
expression.summary: Regular expression, or a reference to a global regular expression, that the host inventory field value must match.

inventory_link.name: InventoryLink
inventory_link.summary: Number of the host inventory field the expression is matched against, from 1 to 70.

sortorder.name: Position
sortorder.summary: Order in which the mappings are tried; the first that matches sets the icon.

iconmapid.summary: ID of the icon map the mapping belongs to.

name.name: Name
name.summary: The unique name of the image.

imagetype.name: ImageType
imagetype.summary: Whether the image is an icon or a map background.

image.name: ImageData
image.summary: The image data, encoded in Base64; returned only when the image data is selected.

ImageGetParameters.summary: Query parameters for the image .get API method.

imageids.name: ImageIds
imageids.summary: Limits the result to the images whose IDs are listed.

sysmapids.name: MapIds
sysmapids.summary: Return only images used by the given maps, either as the background or as an element icon.

select_image.name: SelectImage
select_image.summary: When set, return the image data, encoded in Base64, in the image property.

output.name: Output
output.summary: The image properties to return, either as a list of property names or as extend for all of them; extend is the default.

filter.name: Filter
filter.summary: Return only images whose properties exactly match the given values; each key is a property name and each value is a single value or an array of accepted values.

search.name: Search
search.summary: Return only images whose string properties match the given patterns; by default a property matches when it contains the text, without regard to case.

searchWildcardsEnabled.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
searchWildcardsEnabled.summary: When true, an asterisk in a search pattern matches any sequence of characters.

searchByAny.name: SearchByAny
searchByAny.summary: When true, return images that match any of the search patterns instead of all of them.

startSearch.name: StartSearch
startSearch.summary: When true, a search pattern matches only at the start of the property value instead of anywhere in it.

excludeSearch.name: ExcludeSearch
excludeSearch.summary: When true, return images that do not match the search patterns.

limit.name: Limit
limit.summary: The maximum number of images to return.

sortfield.name: SortField
sortfield.summary: The properties to sort images by; accepted values are imageid and name.

sortorder.name: SortOrder
sortorder.summary: The direction for each sort property: ASC for ascending, the default, or DESC for descending.

countOutput.name: CountOutput
countOutput.summary: When true, return the number of matching images instead of the records.

editable.name: Editable
editable.summary: When true, return an empty result for users below the Zabbix admin type; other users receive every matching image.

preservekeys.name: PreserveKeys
preservekeys.summary: When true, return the result as an object keyed by image ID instead of an array.

Item.summary: The item read model, as returned by the Zabbix API.

itemid.name: ItemId
itemid.summary: ID of the item.

hostid.name: HostId
hostid.summary: The host or template that owns the item, by ID.

name.name: Name
name.summary: The visible name of the item; it may contain user macros.

key_.name: Key
key_.summary: The item key, which identifies the metric to collect and must be unique on the host or template.

type.name: Type
type.summary: The kind of check that collects the item's values, such as Zabbix agent, SNMP agent, HTTP agent, calculated, dependent or script.

value_type.name: ValueType
value_type.summary: Type of the values the item stores: float, character, log, unsigned, text, binary or JSON.

delay.name: Delay
delay.summary: Update interval, as a time unit with a suffix (30s, 1m) or a user macro, optionally followed by custom flexible and scheduling intervals separated by semicolons.

history.name: History
history.summary: How long the server keeps the values, as a time unit with a suffix (0 keeps none) or a user macro.

trends.name: Trends
trends.summary: How long the server keeps the hourly trends of a numeric item, as a time unit with a suffix (0 keeps none) or a user macro.

status.name: Status
status.summary: Whether the item is enabled; a disabled item is not polled.

state.name: State
state.summary: Whether the server can process the item: normal or not supported.

description.name: Description
description.summary: A free-text description of the item.

units.name: Units
units.summary: Units of the values, such as B or %; B, Bps, s and uptime are scaled when shown.

lastvalue.name: LastValue
lastvalue.summary: The item's most recent value, as text.

lastclock.name: LastClock
lastclock.summary: Time of the item's most recent value, as a Unix timestamp; 0 when it has none.

prevvalue.name: PrevValue
prevvalue.summary: The value the item received before its most recent one.

error.name: Error
error.summary: Why the server could not process the item; empty while it is supported.

flags.name: Flags
flags.summary: What low-level discovery made of the item: a plain item, a discovery rule or prototype, or one created by discovery.

interfaceid.name: InterfaceId
interfaceid.summary: ID of the host interface the item is polled through; 0 for a type that uses no interface.

templateid.name: TemplateId
templateid.summary: ID of the item in the template it was inherited from; 0 when it was not inherited.

url.name: Url
url.summary: The URL that HTTP agent items request; it may contain user macros.

query_fields.name: QueryFields
query_fields.summary: The query parameters that HTTP agent items append to the URL, as name and value pairs.

headers.name: Headers
headers.summary: The HTTP headers that HTTP agent items send, as name and value pairs.

snmp_oid.name: SnmpOid
snmp_oid.summary: The SNMP object identifier to query for SNMP agent items; it may use the get[] or walk[] form to request one value or a whole subtree.

master_itemid.name: MasterItemId
master_itemid.summary: The ID of the master item whose values feed this dependent item.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.summary: How long to wait for the item's data, as a time unit from 1 second to 10 minutes; an empty value uses the timeout configured on the proxy or server for the item type.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.summary: The named parameters passed to the script of script items, as name and value pairs.

valuemapid.name: ValueMapId
valuemapid.summary: The ID of the value map used to display the item's values; applies only to numeric and character items.

preprocessing.name: Preprocessing
preprocessing.summary: The preprocessing steps applied to the item's values before they are stored, in order.

name_resolved.name: NameResolved
name_resolved.summary: The item name with user macros resolved.

lastns.name: LastNs
lastns.summary: The nanosecond part of the time when the item last received a value.

allow_traps.name: AllowTraps
allow_traps.summary: Whether an HTTP agent item also accepts values pushed to it as if it were a trapper item.

authtype.name: AuthType
authtype.summary: The authentication method, a number whose meaning depends on the item type: for an SSH agent item 0 password, 1 public key; for an HTTP agent item 0 none, 1 basic, 2 NTLM, 3 Kerberos, 4 digest. The default is 0.

follow_redirects.name: FollowRedirects
follow_redirects.summary: Whether HTTP agent items follow HTTP redirects.

http_proxy.name: HttpProxy
http_proxy.summary: The HTTP or HTTPS proxy that HTTP agent items connect through, in the form [protocol://][user[:password]@]proxy.example.com[:port].

inventory_link.name: InventoryLink
inventory_link.summary: Which host inventory field, by its number, receives the item's latest value; 0 leaves the inventory untouched.

ipmi_sensor.name: IpmiSensor
ipmi_sensor.summary: The name of the IPMI sensor to read for IPMI agent items.

jmx_endpoint.name: JmxEndpoint
jmx_endpoint.summary: The connection string the Java gateway uses to reach the JMX agent for JMX items.

logtimefmt.name: LogTimeFmt
logtimefmt.summary: The pattern used to read the time stamp from each log entry; applies only to items whose value type is log.

output_format.name: OutputFormat
output_format.summary: Whether HTTP agent items store the response as received or convert it to JSON.

params.name: Params
params.summary: Parameters of the item type: the formula of a calculated item, the SQL query of a database monitor item, the script of an SSH, Telnet or script item.

password.name: Password
password.summary: The password for authentication; used by SSH, Telnet, database monitor, JMX, simple check and HTTP agent items.

post_type.name: PostType
post_type.summary: The format of the request body that HTTP agent items send: raw data, JSON or XML.

posts.name: Posts
posts.summary: The request body that HTTP agent items send.

privatekey.name: PrivateKey
privatekey.summary: The name of the private key file used by SSH items that authenticate with a key pair.

publickey.name: PublicKey
publickey.summary: The name of the public key file used by SSH items that authenticate with a key pair.

request_method.name: RequestMethod
request_method.summary: The HTTP method that HTTP agent items use: GET, POST, PUT or HEAD.

retrieve_mode.name: RetrieveMode
retrieve_mode.summary: Which part of the HTTP response HTTP agent items store: the body, the headers, or both.

ssl_cert_file.name: SslCertFile
ssl_cert_file.summary: The path of the public SSL certificate file that HTTP agent items present to the server.

ssl_key_file.name: SslKeyFile
ssl_key_file.summary: The path of the private SSL key file that HTTP agent items use for client authentication.

ssl_key_password.name: SslKeyPassword
ssl_key_password.summary: The password that protects the SSL private key file of HTTP agent items.

status_codes.name: StatusCodes
status_codes.summary: The HTTP status codes an HTTP agent response must have to be accepted, as a comma-separated list of codes and ranges such as 200,301-302.

trapper_hosts.name: TrapperHosts
trapper_hosts.summary: The addresses or DNS names allowed to send values for trapper items and HTTP agent items that accept trapping, as a comma-separated list; an empty value accepts any host.

username.name: Username
username.summary: The user name for authentication; used by SSH, Telnet, database monitor, JMX, simple check and HTTP agent items.

verify_host.name: VerifyHost
verify_host.summary: Whether HTTP agent items check that the host name in the URL matches the server certificate.

verify_peer.name: VerifyPeer
verify_peer.summary: Whether HTTP agent items verify the certificate of the web server.

tags.name: Tags
tags.summary: The tags assigned to the item.

triggers.name: Triggers
triggers.summary: The triggers that use the item; returned when triggers are selected.

valuemap.name: ValueMap
valuemap.summary: The value map used by the item; returned when the value map is selected.

lookback_limit.summary: How far back telemetry query items look for data when earlier updates are missing or too old, as a time unit from 1 second to 3 days; it must not be smaller than the granularity.

query.summary: The telemetry query that telemetry query items run: the signal type, the columns to return or aggregate, and the filter conditions.

time_shift.summary: How far telemetry query items shift their processing window back from the current time, as a time unit from 0 to 1 day.

selectDiscoveryRule.name: SelectDiscoveryRule
selectDiscoveryRule.summary: Adds, under `discoveryRule`, the low-level discovery rule that produced each item.

tags.name: Tags
tags.summary: Filters items by tag. Every condition gives a tag, an operator and a value.

output.name: Output
output.summary: The item properties to return, either as a list of property names or as extend for all of them; extend is the default.

filter.name: Filter
filter.summary: Return only items whose properties exactly match the given values; each key is a property name and each value is a single value or an array of accepted values.

search.name: Search
search.summary: Return only items whose string properties match the given patterns; by default a property matches when it contains the text, without regard to case.

searchWildcardsEnabled.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
searchWildcardsEnabled.summary: When true, an asterisk in a search pattern matches any sequence of characters.

searchByAny.name: SearchByAny
searchByAny.summary: When true, return items that match any of the search patterns instead of all of them.

startSearch.name: StartSearch
startSearch.summary: When true, a search pattern matches only at the start of the property value instead of anywhere in it.

excludeSearch.name: ExcludeSearch
excludeSearch.summary: When true, return items that do not match the search patterns.

limit.name: Limit
limit.summary: The maximum number of items to return.

sortfield.name: SortField
sortfield.summary: The properties to sort items by; accepted values are itemid, name, key_, delay, history, trends, type and status.

sortorder.name: SortOrder
sortorder.summary: The direction for each sort property: ASC for ascending, the default, or DESC for descending.

countOutput.name: CountOutput
countOutput.summary: When true, return the number of matching items instead of the records.

editable.name: Editable
editable.summary: When true, return only items the caller has write permission for.

preservekeys.name: PreserveKeys
preservekeys.summary: When true, return the result as an object keyed by item ID instead of an array.

groupCount.summary: When true together with the count option, return the counts grouped by the ID filter that was used.

inheritedTags.summary: When true, the tag filter also matches tags that the item inherits from its host, template or linked templates.

selectInheritedTags.summary: Return the tags that each item inherits from its host, template and linked templates in the inheritedTags property.

selectItemDiscovery.summary: Return the discovery data of each item in the itemDiscovery property. Deprecated; use the discovery data selection instead.

PreprocessingStep.summary: A preprocessing step of an item, an item prototype or a discovery rule.

itemid.summary: ID of the item, item prototype or discovery rule the step belongs to.

step.summary: Position of the step in the preprocessing sequence; steps run in ascending order.

type.name: Type
type.summary: Type code of the preprocessing step, for example 1 for a custom multiplier, 5 for a regular expression, 12 for JSONPath, or 21 for JavaScript.

params.summary: Parameters of the preprocessing step, one per line, as its type defines them.
params.name: Params

error_handler.name: ErrorHandler
error_handler.summary: What happens when the step fails: 0 makes the value unsupported, 1 discards the value, 2 sets a custom value, 3 sets a custom error message.

error_handler_params.summary: Custom value or custom error message used when the error handler is 2 or 3; empty otherwise.
error_handler_params.name: ErrorHandlerParams

ItemPrototype.summary: The item prototype read model, as returned by the Zabbix API.

itemid.name: ItemId
itemid.summary: ID of the item prototype.

hostid.name: HostId
hostid.summary: The host or template that owns the item prototype, by ID.

name.name: Name
name.summary: Name of the item prototype; may contain user macros and low-level discovery macros.

uuid.name: Uuid
uuid.summary: Universally unique identifier of the item prototype, which matches it to the same item prototype when a configuration is exported and imported.

flags.name: Flags
flags.summary: What low-level discovery made of the item prototype: a plain item prototype, a discovery rule or prototype, or one created by discovery.

key_.name: Key
key_.summary: Item key of the prototype; must contain at least one low-level discovery macro and be unique within the discovery rule's host.

type.name: Type
type.summary: Type of check the item prototype performs, which decides how items created from it collect data.

value_type.name: ValueType
value_type.summary: Type of the values the item stores: float, character, log, unsigned, text, binary or JSON.

delay.name: Delay
delay.summary: Update interval, as a time unit with a suffix (30s, 1m) or a user macro, optionally followed by custom flexible and scheduling intervals separated by semicolons.

history.name: History
history.summary: How long the server keeps the values, as a time unit with a suffix (0 keeps none) or a user macro.

trends.name: Trends
trends.summary: How long the server keeps the hourly trends of a numeric item, as a time unit with a suffix (0 keeps none) or a user macro.

status.name: Status
status.summary: Enabled or disabled state of the item prototype; enabled unless set.

description.name: Description
description.summary: Free-form description of the item prototype.

templateid.name: TemplateId
templateid.summary: ID of the item prototype in the template it was inherited from; 0 when it was not inherited.

interfaceid.name: InterfaceId
interfaceid.summary: ID of the host interface the item prototype is polled through; 0 for a type that uses no interface.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.summary: Item check timeout (HTTP-agent / script items), e.g. "3s".

master_itemid.name: MasterItemId
master_itemid.summary: Master item id for a dependent item prototype.

valuemapid.name: ValueMapId
valuemapid.summary: Value map id applied to the discovered items.

username.name: Username
username.summary: Username (simple-check / SSH / Telnet / JMX / HTTP-agent items).

password.name: Password
password.summary: Password (simple-check / SSH / Telnet / JMX / HTTP-agent items).

publickey.name: PublicKey
publickey.summary: Public key file (SSH items with public-key auth).

privatekey.name: PrivateKey
privatekey.summary: Private key file (SSH items with public-key auth).

authtype.name: AuthType
authtype.summary: The authentication method, a number whose meaning depends on the item type: for an SSH agent item 0 password, 1 public key; for an HTTP agent item 0 none, 1 basic, 2 NTLM, 3 Kerberos, 4 digest. The default is 0.

url.name: Url
url.summary: Request URL (HTTP-agent items).

query_fields.name: QueryFields
query_fields.summary: Query fields appended to the URL (HTTP-agent items).

retrieve_mode.name: RetrieveMode
retrieve_mode.summary: Whether the response body, headers, or both are stored.

output_format.name: OutputFormat
output_format.summary: Output format: store raw, or convert to JSON.

allow_traps.name: AllowTraps
allow_traps.summary: Allow the HTTP-agent item to also accept incoming (trapper) data.

verify_host.name: VerifyHost
verify_host.summary: Validate the server certificate host name.

verify_peer.name: VerifyPeer
verify_peer.summary: Validate that the server certificate is trusted.

trapper_hosts.name: TrapperHosts
trapper_hosts.summary: Allowed hosts for a trapper item prototype.

discover.name: Discover
discover.summary: Whether the discovery rule creates new items from this prototype (default ).

tags.name: Tags
tags.summary: Tags assigned to the item prototype and passed on to the items created from it. Returned only when tags are selected.

preprocessing.name: Preprocessing
preprocessing.summary: Preprocessing steps applied, in order, to values of items created from the prototype. Returned only when preprocessing is selected.

granularity.summary: Length of each aggregation bucket inside the processing window, as a time unit from 1 second to 1 day; may not exceed the lookback limit. Defaults to 15s. Applies to telemetry query item prototypes.

lookback_limit.summary: How far back the processing window may reach when earlier updates are missing or stale, as a time unit from 1 second to 3 days; supports macros. Defaults to 10m. Applies to telemetry query item prototypes.

query.summary: Telemetry query definition: the signal type (traces, metrics or logs), the columns to read, the aggregated columns with their functions, and the filter conditions. Required when the type is telemetry query.

time_shift.summary: How far the processing window is shifted back in time, as a time unit from 0 to 1 day; supports user macros and low-level discovery macros. Defaults to 15s. Applies to telemetry query item prototypes.

ItemPrototypeGetParameters.summary: Query parameters for the item prototype .get API method.

itemids.name: ItemIds
itemids.summary: Limits the result to the item prototypes whose IDs are listed.

hostids.name: HostIds
hostids.summary: Keeps item prototypes defined on any of the listed hosts.

discoveryids.name: DiscoveryIds
discoveryids.summary: Return only item prototypes that belong to the given low-level discovery rules.

templateids.name: TemplateIds
templateids.summary: Keeps item prototypes owned by any of the listed templates.

graphids.name: GraphIds
graphids.summary: Keeps item prototypes that appear in any of the listed graph prototypes.

triggerids.name: TriggerIds
triggerids.summary: Keeps item prototypes referenced by any of the listed trigger prototypes.

templated.name: Templated
templated.summary: When true, keeps only item prototypes owned by templates.

inherited.name: Inherited
inherited.summary: When true, keeps item prototypes that came from a template.

monitored.name: Monitored
monitored.summary: When true, keeps only enabled item prototypes on monitored hosts.

selectHosts.name: SelectHosts
selectHosts.summary: Return a hosts property with the host the item prototype belongs to.

selectTriggers.name: SelectTriggers
selectTriggers.summary: Adds, under `triggers`, the trigger prototypes that reference the item prototype. Supports count.

selectGraphs.name: SelectGraphs
selectGraphs.summary: Adds the graph prototypes that reference the item prototype under `graphs`. Supports count.

selectPreprocessing.name: SelectPreprocessing
selectPreprocessing.summary: Return a preprocessing property with the preprocessing steps of the item prototype.

selectTags.name: SelectTags
selectTags.summary: Return a tags property with the item prototype tags.

selectValueMap.name: SelectValueMap
selectValueMap.summary: Return a valuemap property with the value map of the item prototype.

selectDiscoveryRule.name: SelectDiscoveryRule
selectDiscoveryRule.summary: Adds the item prototype's parent low-level discovery rule under `discoveryRule`.

selectDiscoveryRulePrototype.name: SelectDiscoveryRulePrototype
selectDiscoveryRulePrototype.summary: Return a discoveryRulePrototype property with the parent low-level discovery rule prototype the item prototype belongs to.

selectDiscoveryData.name: SelectDiscoveryData
selectDiscoveryData.summary: Return a discoveryData property linking a discovered item prototype to the prototype it came from, with its discovery status and pending delete or disable times.

output.name: Output
output.summary: The item prototype properties to return: a list of property names, or extend for all of them. The object ID is always included. Defaults to extend.

filter.name: Filter
filter.summary: Exact-match filter: an object whose keys are item prototype properties, or host for the technical host name, and whose values are a single value or an array of accepted values. Text-type properties are not supported.

search.name: Search
search.summary: Case-insensitive pattern search: an object whose keys are item prototype properties and whose values are substrings to look for. By default a value matches anywhere in the property.

searchWildcardsEnabled.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
searchWildcardsEnabled.summary: If true, an asterisk in a search value acts as a wildcard. Defaults to false.

searchByAny.name: SearchByAny
searchByAny.summary: If true, return results that match any of the filter or search criteria rather than all of them. Defaults to false.

startSearch.name: StartSearch
startSearch.summary: If true, the search criteria match only at the beginning of a property value instead of anywhere in it. Ignored when wildcards are enabled.

excludeSearch.name: ExcludeSearch
excludeSearch.summary: If true, return the results that do not match the search criteria.

limit.name: Limit
limit.summary: Maximum number of records to return.

sortfield.name: SortField
sortfield.summary: Properties to sort the result by. Allowed values: itemid, name, key_, delay, history, trends, type, status, discover. Without it the result is unsorted.

sortorder.name: SortOrder
sortorder.summary: Sort direction, ascending or descending; when a list is given, each entry applies to the sort field at the same position. Defaults to ascending.

countOutput.name: CountOutput
countOutput.summary: If true, return the number of matching records instead of the records themselves.

editable.name: Editable
editable.summary: If true, return only item prototypes the user has write permission to. Defaults to false.

preservekeys.name: PreserveKeys
preservekeys.summary: If true, key the result by object ID instead of returning a plain array.

groupCount.summary: Together with count output and a host or discovery rule filter, return one count per host or rule instead of a single total.

limitSelects.summary: Maximum number of records each subselect returns; applies to the graph and trigger subselects.

selectInheritedTags.summary: Return an inheritedTags property with the tags found on the template or host and its linked templates.

MaintenanceCreateRequest.summary: Write-request payload for the maintenance .create API method.

name.name: Name
name.summary: The unique name of the maintenance; required.

active_since.name: ActiveSince
active_since.summary: The Unix time at which the maintenance becomes active, inclusive and rounded down to the minute; required.

active_till.name: ActiveTill
active_till.summary: End of the maintenance window as a Unix time. The window ends just before this instant, the server truncates it to whole minutes, and it must come after the start. Required.

maintenance_type.name: MaintenanceType
maintenance_type.summary: Whether data is still collected during the maintenance (the default) or collection stops for the affected hosts.

description.name: Description
description.summary: A free-form description of the maintenance.

groups.name: Groups
groups.summary: The host groups whose hosts are placed in maintenance.

timeperiods.name: TimePeriods
timeperiods.summary: The recurring or one-time periods during which the maintenance takes effect; at least one is required.

tags.name: Tags
tags.summary: The problem tags that select which problems the maintenance suppresses; allowed only for maintenance with data collection.

tags_evaltype.name: TagsEvalType
tags_evaltype.summary: How the problem tags are combined: And/Or (the default), where tags with different names must all match, or Or, where any tag may match. Allowed only for maintenance with data collection.

event_names.summary: Conditions on the problem event name (contains or does not contain a string) that limit which problems the maintenance suppresses; allowed only for maintenance with data collection.

groupids.summary: The IDs of the host groups to place in maintenance. Deprecated in favour of the groups list, and accepted only by Zabbix 7.0.

hostids.summary: The IDs of the hosts to place in maintenance. Deprecated in favour of the hosts list, and accepted only by Zabbix 7.0.

triggers.summary: The triggers whose problems the maintenance applies to; allowed only for maintenance with data collection. At least one host group, host or trigger must be given.

hostids.name: HostIds
hostids.summary: Return only maintenances that cover the given hosts.

groupids.name: GroupIds
groupids.summary: Return only maintenances that cover the given host groups, directly or through their hosts.

selectHostGroups.name: SelectHostGroups
selectHostGroups.summary: Return the host groups in maintenance in a hostgroups property.

selectHosts.name: SelectHosts
selectHosts.summary: Return the hosts in maintenance in a hosts property.

selectTimeperiods.name: SelectTimePeriods
selectTimeperiods.summary: Return the time periods of the maintenance in a timeperiods property.

selectTags.name: SelectTags
selectTags.summary: Return the problem tags of the maintenance in a tags property.

output.name: Output
output.summary: Which properties to return for each object, given as a list of property names or extend to return all of them.

filter.name: Filter
filter.summary: Return only maintenances whose properties exactly match the given values; each key is a property name and each value is a single value or an array of accepted values.

search.name: Search
search.summary: Return only maintenances whose properties contain the given strings, using a case-insensitive substring match by default; each key is a property name.

searchWildcardsEnabled.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
searchWildcardsEnabled.summary: Whether an asterisk in a search string acts as a wildcard that matches any sequence of characters.

searchByAny.name: SearchByAny
searchByAny.summary: Whether an object that matches any one of the search or filter criteria is returned; by default every criterion must match.

startSearch.name: StartSearch
startSearch.summary: Whether the search strings must match the beginning of the property value rather than any part of it.

excludeSearch.name: ExcludeSearch
excludeSearch.summary: Whether to return the objects that do not match the search criteria instead of those that do.

limit.name: Limit
limit.summary: The maximum number of maintenances to return.

sortfield.name: SortField
sortfield.summary: The properties to sort the result by; accepted values are maintenanceid, name, maintenance_type, active_since and active_till.

sortorder.name: SortOrder
sortorder.summary: The sort direction for each sort field, ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC); ascending when omitted.

countOutput.name: CountOutput
countOutput.summary: Whether to return the number of matching maintenances instead of the maintenances themselves.

editable.name: Editable
editable.summary: Whether to return only maintenances that the current user is allowed to change.

preservekeys.name: PreserveKeys
preservekeys.summary: Whether the result is keyed by object ID instead of being returned as a plain array.

groupCount.summary: Whether, together with countOutput, the count is returned as an array of result rows instead of a single number.

selectEventNames.summary: Return the event name conditions of the maintenance in an event_names property.

selectGroups.summary: Return the host groups of the maintenance in a groups property. Deprecated in favour of selectHostGroups, and accepted only by Zabbix 7.0.

selectTriggers.summary: Return the triggers the maintenance applies to in a triggers property.

name.name: Name

active_since.name: ActiveSince

active_till.name: ActiveTill
active_till.summary: End of the maintenance window as a Unix time. The window ends just before this instant, the server truncates it to whole minutes, and it must come after the start.

description.name: Description

maintenance_type.name: MaintenanceType
maintenance_type.summary: Whether data is still collected during the maintenance (the default) or collection stops for the affected hosts.

tags_evaltype.summary: How the problem tags are combined: And/Or (the default), where tags with different names must all match, or Or, where any tag may match. Allowed only for maintenance with data collection.

groups.name: Groups
groups.summary: Host groups. Wire field groups on create/update.

hostgroups.summary: The host groups <c>selectHostGroups</c> returns (7.0+); <c>groups</c> is the name 7.0 deprecated. Wire field hostgroups.

timeperiods.name: TimePeriods
timeperiods.summary: The time periods of the maintenance; returned when selectTimeperiods is requested.

tags.name: Tags
tags.summary: The problem tags of the maintenance; returned when selectTags is requested.

search.name: Search
search.summary: Case-insensitive pattern search: an object whose keys are map properties and whose values are substrings to look for. By default a value matches anywhere in the property.

searchWildcardsEnabled.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
searchWildcardsEnabled.summary: If true, an asterisk in a search value acts as a wildcard. Defaults to false.

searchByAny.name: SearchByAny
searchByAny.summary: If true, return results that match any of the filter or search criteria rather than all of them. Defaults to false.

startSearch.name: StartSearch
startSearch.summary: If true, the search criteria match only at the beginning of a property value instead of anywhere in it. Ignored when wildcards are enabled.

excludeSearch.name: ExcludeSearch
excludeSearch.summary: If true, return the results that do not match the search criteria.

limit.name: Limit
limit.summary: Maximum number of records to return.

sortfield.name: SortField
sortfield.summary: Properties to sort the result by. Allowed values: name, width, height. Without it the result is unsorted.

sortorder.name: SortOrder
sortorder.summary: Sort direction, ascending or descending; when a list is given, each entry applies to the sort field at the same position. Defaults to ascending.

countOutput.name: CountOutput
countOutput.summary: If true, return the number of matching records instead of the records themselves.

editable.name: Editable
editable.summary: If true, return only maps the user has write permission to. Defaults to false.

preservekeys.name: PreserveKeys
preservekeys.summary: If true, key the result by object ID instead of returning a plain array.

y1.name: Y1

x2.name: X2
x2.summary: The X coordinate of the line's end point, in pixels.

y2.name: Y2
y2.summary: The Y coordinate of the line's end point, in pixels.

line_type.name: LineType

line_color.name: LineColor

zindex.name: ZIndex

show_label.summary: Whether the link label is always shown or hidden until the pointer is over the link, or follows the map setting.

type.summary: The kind of shape: rectangle or ellipse.

y.name: Y

width.name: Width

height.name: Height

text.name: Text

font_color.name: FontColor

text_halign.summary: Horizontal alignment of the shape's text: center, left or right.

text_valign.name: TextVAlign
text_valign.summary: Vertical alignment of the shape's text: middle, top or bottom.

border_type.name: BorderType
border_type.summary: The style of the border: none, solid, dotted or dashed.

border_width.name: BorderWidth
border_width.summary: Border width, in pixels, between 0 and 50.

border_color.name: BorderColor
border_color.summary: The color of the border, as a six-digit hexadecimal RGB value; defaults to 000000.

background_color.name: BackgroundColor
background_color.summary: The fill color of the shape, as a six-digit hexadecimal RGB value; empty means transparent.

zindex.name: ZIndex
zindex.summary: The stacking order of the shape among shapes and lines; higher values are drawn on top.

sysmapid.summary: The ID of the map that the shape belongs to.

name.name: Name
name.summary: Link caption shown in the element's menu.

url.name: Url
url.summary: Link target; macros are allowed.

elementtype.name: ElementType
elementtype.summary: Kind of map element the URL is added to: host, map, trigger, host group or image.

sysmapuserid.summary: ID of the map sharing record.

userid.name: UserId
userid.summary: ID of the user the map is shared with.

permission.summary: Access the user has to the map: 2 read-only, 3 read-write.

sysmapusrgrpid.summary: The ID of the map sharing entry.

usrgrpid.name: UserGroupId
usrgrpid.summary: The ID of the user group that the map is shared with.

permission.name: Permission
permission.summary: The access granted to the user group: 2 read-only, 3 read-write.

event_menu_url.summary: The URL that the event menu entry opens; it may use the {EVENT.TAGS.<name>} macro. Required when the event menu entry is shown.

event_menu_name.summary: The label of the event menu entry. Required when the event menu entry is shown.

refresh_token.name: RefreshToken

message_templates.summary: The default message templates of the media type, one per event source and operation mode.

mediatypeids.name: MediaTypeIds
mediatypeids.summary: Limits the result to the media types whose IDs are listed.

mediaids.name: MediaIds
mediaids.summary: Keeps media types referenced by any of the listed user media.

userids.name: UserIds
userids.summary: Keeps media types that any of the listed users rely on.

selectMessageTemplates.name: SelectMessageTemplates
selectMessageTemplates.summary: Return the message templates of each media type in the message_templates property.

selectUsers.name: SelectUsers
selectUsers.summary: Return the users that use each media type in the users property.

selectActions.name: SelectActions
selectActions.summary: Return the actions that send messages through each media type in the actions property.

output.name: Output
output.summary: The media type properties to return, either as a list of property names or as extend for all of them; extend is the default.

filter.name: Filter
filter.summary: Return only media types whose properties exactly match the given values; each key is a property name and each value is a single value or an array of accepted values.

search.name: Search
search.summary: Return only media types whose string properties match the given patterns; by default a property matches when it contains the text, without regard to case.

searchWildcardsEnabled.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
searchWildcardsEnabled.summary: When true, an asterisk in a search pattern matches any sequence of characters.

searchByAny.name: SearchByAny
searchByAny.summary: When true, return media types that match any of the search patterns instead of all of them.

startSearch.name: StartSearch
startSearch.summary: When true, a search pattern matches only at the start of the property value instead of anywhere in it.

excludeSearch.name: ExcludeSearch
excludeSearch.summary: When true, return media types that do not match the search patterns.

limit.name: Limit
limit.summary: The maximum number of media types to return.

sortfield.name: SortField
sortfield.summary: The property to sort media types by; the only accepted value is mediatypeid.

sortorder.name: SortOrder
sortorder.summary: The direction for each sort property: ASC for ascending, the default, or DESC for descending.

countOutput.name: CountOutput
countOutput.summary: When true, return the number of matching media types instead of the records.

editable.name: Editable
editable.summary: When true, return only media types the caller has write permission for.

preservekeys.name: PreserveKeys
preservekeys.summary: When true, return the result as an object keyed by media type ID instead of an array.

groupCount.summary: When true together with the count option, return the counts grouped by the ID filter that was used.

name.name: Name
name.summary: Parameter name (webhook media types); absent for script media types, whose parameters are positional (<c>sortorder</c>, <c>value</c>).

value.name: Value
value.summary: Value of the parameter passed to the webhook or script; macros are allowed.

sortorder.name: Position
sortorder.summary: Positional order for EXEC (script) media-type parameters. Null for webhook parameters.

searchByAny.name: SearchByAny

tokenids.name: TokenIds

Trigger.summary: The trigger read model, as returned by the Zabbix API.

description.name: Name
description.summary: Name of the trigger, as the frontend shows it; it may contain macros. The API calls it <c>description</c>; the free-text description is <see cref="Description"/>.

expression.name: Expression
expression.summary: Problem expression that the server evaluates to decide whether the trigger is in the problem state; item references appear as function IDs unless expandExpression is requested.

recovery_expression.name: RecoveryExpression
recovery_expression.summary: Expression that resolves the problem when it evaluates to true; used only when the recovery mode is the recovery expression.

recovery_mode.name: RecoveryMode
recovery_mode.summary: How the trigger decides that a problem is resolved: when the problem expression is false, when the recovery expression is true, or never (problems are only closed manually or by correlation). Defaults to the problem expression.

priority.name: Priority
priority.summary: Severity of the trigger, from not classified to disaster. Defaults to not classified.

status.name: Status
status.summary: Whether the trigger is enabled; a disabled trigger is not evaluated.

value.name: Value
value.summary: Current state of the trigger: OK or problem.

state.name: State
state.summary: Whether the server can evaluate the trigger: normal or unknown.

type.name: Type
type.summary: Whether the trigger generates a single problem event or a new problem event on every evaluation that results in a problem. Defaults to a single event.

url.name: Url
url.summary: URL associated with the trigger and shown with its problems; user macros allowed.

url_name.name: UrlName
url_name.summary: Label shown for the trigger URL; user macros allowed.

comments.name: Description
comments.summary: Description of the trigger, the free text the frontend shows as its description; it may contain macros. The API calls it <c>comments</c>; the trigger's name is <see cref="Name"/>.

error.name: Error
error.summary: Why the server could not evaluate the trigger; empty while its state is normal.

flags.name: Flags
flags.summary: What low-level discovery made of the trigger: a plain trigger, a discovery rule or prototype, or one created by discovery.

lastchange.name: LastChange
lastchange.summary: Unix timestamp of the trigger's most recent state change.

templateid.name: TemplateId
templateid.summary: ID of the trigger in the template it was inherited from; 0 when it was not inherited.

opdata.name: Opdata
opdata.summary: Operational data shown with the trigger's problems; it may contain macros.

event_name.name: EventName
event_name.summary: Template for the names of the events the trigger generates, with macros allowed; when empty, the trigger name is used.

correlation_mode.name: CorrelationMode
correlation_mode.summary: Which problems an OK event closes: all problems of the trigger, or only problems whose value for the correlation tag matches. Defaults to all problems.

correlation_tag.name: CorrelationTag
correlation_tag.summary: Tag whose value must match for an OK event to close a problem when the correlation mode is tag based.

manual_close.name: ManualClose
manual_close.summary: Whether users may close the trigger's problems manually. Defaults to not allowed.

uuid.name: Uuid
uuid.summary: Universally unique identifier of the trigger, which matches it to the same trigger when a configuration is exported and imported.

tags.name: Tags
tags.summary: Tags of the trigger; returned when selectTags is requested.

hosts.name: Hosts
hosts.summary: Hosts or templates the trigger belongs to; returned when selectHosts is requested.

items.name: Items
items.summary: Items used in the trigger expressions; returned when selectItems is requested.

functions.name: Functions
functions.summary: Functions used in the trigger expressions; returned when selectFunctions is requested.

dependencies.name: Dependencies
dependencies.summary: Triggers this trigger depends on; returned when selectDependencies is requested.
