expression.summary: The problem expression of the trigger prototype; it must reference at least one item prototype, and item prototypes of binary or JSON type are not allowed.

recovery_expression.name: RecoveryExpression
recovery_expression.summary: The expression that resolves the problem when the recovery mode uses a recovery expression; it must reference at least one item prototype.

recovery_mode.name: RecoveryMode
recovery_mode.summary: How discovered triggers return to OK: by the problem expression (the default), by a separate recovery expression, or never automatically.

priority.name: Priority
priority.summary: The severity of triggers discovered from the prototype; not classified by default.

status.name: Status
status.summary: Trigger prototype status, enabled by default; a disabled prototype yields no discovered triggers.

comments.name: Description
comments.summary: Description of the trigger prototype, the free text the frontend shows as its description; it may contain macros. The API calls it <c>comments</c>; the trigger prototype's name is <see cref="Name"/>.

url.name: Url
url.summary: URL linked to the trigger prototype and displayed alongside its problems.

url_name.name: UrlName
url_name.summary: Link text shown for the URL of triggers made from this prototype.

templateid.name: TemplateId
templateid.summary: ID of the trigger prototype in the template it was inherited from; 0 when it was not inherited.

type.name: Type
type.summary: Whether discovered triggers generate a new problem event on every evaluation in the problem state, or only one event per problem. Single event by default.

correlation_mode.name: CorrelationMode
correlation_mode.summary: Which problems an OK event closes: all problems of the trigger (the default), or only those whose correlation tag values match.

correlation_tag.name: CorrelationTag
correlation_tag.summary: The tag whose value must match for an OK event to close a problem when correlation by tag is used.

manual_close.name: ManualClose
manual_close.summary: Whether users can close problems of discovered triggers manually. Not allowed by default.

opdata.name: Opdata
opdata.summary: The operational data shown with problems, usually item values referenced through macros.

event_name.name: EventName
event_name.summary: The name given to problem events generated by triggers discovered from this prototype; when empty the trigger name is used.

discover.name: Discover
discover.summary: Whether the discovery rule creates new triggers from this prototype (default ).

tags.name: Tags
tags.summary: The tags of the trigger prototype; returned when selectTags is requested.

dependencies.name: Dependencies
dependencies.summary: The triggers and trigger prototypes that the trigger prototype depends on; returned when selectDependencies is requested.

TriggerPrototypeGetParameters.summary: Query parameters for the trigger prototype .get API method.

triggerids.name: TriggerIds
triggerids.summary: Limits the result to the trigger prototypes whose IDs are listed.

hostids.name: HostIds
hostids.summary: Keeps trigger prototypes owned by any of the listed hosts or templates.

discoveryids.name: DiscoveryIds
discoveryids.summary: Return only trigger prototypes that belong to the given low-level discovery rules.

templateids.name: TemplateIds
templateids.summary: Keeps trigger prototypes owned by any of the listed templates.

groupids.name: GroupIds
groupids.summary: Keeps trigger prototypes whose hosts or templates are members of the listed host groups or template groups.

min_severity.name: MinSeverity
min_severity.summary: Return only trigger prototypes whose severity is at least the given value, from 0 (not classified) to 5 (disaster).

active.name: Active
active.summary: Keeps enabled trigger prototypes on monitored hosts only.

inherited.name: Inherited
inherited.summary: When true, return only trigger prototypes inherited from a template; when false, only those that are not inherited.

templated.name: Templated
templated.summary: When true, return only trigger prototypes that belong to templates; when false, only those that belong to hosts.

monitored.name: Monitored
monitored.summary: Keeps enabled trigger prototypes on monitored hosts whose items are all enabled.

maintenance.name: Maintenance
maintenance.summary: When true, return only enabled trigger prototypes of hosts in maintenance; when false, only those of hosts not in maintenance.

expandExpression.name: ExpandExpression
expandExpression.summary: Whether function references and macros in the returned expressions are expanded.

selectHosts.name: SelectHosts
selectHosts.summary: Adds the trigger prototype's owning hosts and templates under `hosts`.

selectHostGroups.name: SelectHostGroups
selectHostGroups.summary: Adds the trigger prototype's host groups under `hostgroups`.

selectTemplateGroups.name: SelectTemplateGroups
selectTemplateGroups.summary: Adds, under `templategroups`, the template groups holding the trigger prototype.

selectItems.name: SelectItems
selectItems.summary: Adds, under `items`, the items and item prototypes the trigger prototype references.

selectFunctions.name: SelectFunctions
selectFunctions.summary: Return the functions used in the trigger prototype expressions in a functions property.

selectDependencies.name: SelectDependencies
selectDependencies.summary: Return the triggers and trigger prototypes that the trigger prototype depends on in a dependencies property.

selectTags.name: SelectTags
selectTags.summary: Return the tags of the trigger prototype in a tags property.

selectDiscoveryRule.name: SelectDiscoveryRule
selectDiscoveryRule.summary: Return the low-level discovery rule that the trigger prototype belongs to in a discoveryRule property.

selectDiscoveryRulePrototype.name: SelectDiscoveryRulePrototype
selectDiscoveryRulePrototype.summary: Return the parent low-level discovery rule prototype of the trigger prototype in a discoveryRulePrototype property.

selectDiscoveryData.name: SelectDiscoveryData
selectDiscoveryData.summary: Return, for a discovered trigger prototype, the link to the prototype it was discovered from and its discovery status in a discoveryData property.

output.name: Output
output.summary: Which properties to return for each object, given as a list of property names or extend to return all of them.

filter.name: Filter
filter.summary: Return only trigger prototypes whose properties exactly match the given values; besides the object properties it accepts host (the technical host name) and hostid.

search.name: Search
search.summary: Return only trigger prototypes whose properties contain the given strings, using a case-insensitive substring match by default; each key is a property name.

searchWildcardsEnabled.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
searchWildcardsEnabled.summary: Whether an asterisk in a search string acts as a wildcard that matches any sequence of characters.

searchByAny.name: SearchByAny
searchByAny.summary: Whether an object that matches any one of the search or filter criteria is returned; by default every criterion must match.

startSearch.name: StartSearch
startSearch.summary: Whether the search strings must match the beginning of the property value rather than any part of it.

excludeSearch.name: ExcludeSearch
excludeSearch.summary: Whether to return the objects that do not match the search criteria instead of those that do.

limit.name: Limit
limit.summary: The maximum number of trigger prototypes to return.

sortfield.name: SortField
sortfield.summary: The properties to sort the result by; accepted values are triggerid, description, status, priority and discovered.

sortorder.name: SortOrder
sortorder.summary: The sort direction for each sort field, ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC); ascending when omitted.

countOutput.name: CountOutput
countOutput.summary: Whether to return the number of matching trigger prototypes instead of the trigger prototypes themselves.

editable.name: Editable
editable.summary: Whether to return only trigger prototypes that the current user is allowed to change.

preservekeys.name: PreserveKeys
preservekeys.summary: Whether the result is keyed by object ID instead of being returned as a plain array.

functions.summary: Return only trigger prototypes whose expressions use the given trigger functions.

group.summary: Filters trigger prototypes by the name of a host group or template group that holds their host or template.

groupCount.summary: Whether, together with countOutput, one count is returned per host group, host, item or discovery rule given in the ID filters instead of a single total.

host.summary: Return only trigger prototypes that belong to the host or template with the given technical name.

itemids.summary: Return only trigger prototypes whose expressions use the given items or item prototypes.

limitSelects.summary: The maximum number of records returned by each subselect, such as selectHosts.

selectGroups.summary: Return the host groups and template groups of the trigger prototype in a groups property. Deprecated in favour of selectHostGroups and selectTemplateGroups, and accepted only by Zabbix 7.0.

selectInheritedTags.summary: Return the tags the trigger prototype inherits from templates, hosts and the item prototypes in its expressions in an inheritedTags property.

User.summary: The user read model, as returned by the Zabbix API.

userid.name: UserId
userid.summary: ID of the user.

username.name: Username
username.summary: Login name of the user; must be unique.

name.name: FirstName
name.summary: First name of the user.

url.name: Url
url.summary: Frontend page the user is sent to after logging in.

autologin.name: AutoLogin
autologin.summary: Whether the user stays logged in across browser sessions.

autologout.name: AutoLogout
autologout.summary: Idle time after which the user session expires, in seconds or with a time suffix: 0 never expires, otherwise 90 seconds to 1 day. Defaults to 15m.

lang.name: Language
lang.summary: Locale the frontend uses for this user, such as en_US; default follows the system-wide setting.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.summary: Automatic page refresh period, in seconds or with a time suffix, up to 1 hour. Defaults to 30s.

theme.name: Theme
theme.summary: Frontend theme of the user, or default for the system default.

rows_per_page.name: RowsPerPage
rows_per_page.summary: Number of rows shown per page in frontend lists, from 1 to 999999. Defaults to 50.

timezone.name: Timezone
timezone.summary: Time zone of the user, such as Europe/London, or default for the system default.

roleid.name: RoleId
roleid.summary: ID of the user role, which sets the user type and what the user may access.

userdirectoryid.name: UserDirectoryId
userdirectoryid.summary: ID of the user directory the user is provisioned from and authenticates against, or 0 for none.

ts_provisioned.name: TsProvisioned
ts_provisioned.summary: Unix timestamp of the latest provisioning of the user from a user directory. Read-only.

attempt_failed.name: AttemptFailed
attempt_failed.summary: Number of recent failed login attempts. Read-only.

attempt_clock.name: AttemptClock
attempt_clock.summary: Unix timestamp of the last failed login attempt. Read-only.

attempt_ip.name: AttemptIp
attempt_ip.summary: IP address of the last failed login attempt. Read-only.

usrgrps.name: UserGroups
usrgrps.summary: User groups the user belongs to. Returned only when user groups are selected.

medias.name: Medias
medias.summary: Notification media of the user. Returned only when media are selected.

role.name: Role
role.summary: Role assigned to the user. Returned only when the role is selected.

default_maintenance_period.summary: Default duration offered when this user creates a maintenance, from 5 minutes to 999 days 23 hours 59 minutes; rounded down to whole minutes. Defaults to 1h.

passwd.summary: Password of the user. Write-only: the server never returns it.

provisioned.summary: Whether the user was created by provisioning from a user directory. Read-only.

username.name: Username
username.summary: Login name of the user; must be unique. Required.

passwd.name: Password
passwd.summary: Password of the user, checked against the password policy.

name.name: FirstName
name.summary: First name of the user.

roleid.name: RoleId
roleid.summary: ID of the user role, which sets the user type and what the user may access.

usrgrps.name: UserGroups
usrgrps.summary: User groups to add the user to; each entry needs only a user group ID.

medias.name: Medias
medias.summary: Notification media to create for the user.

autologin.name: AutoLogin
autologin.summary: Whether the user stays logged in across browser sessions.

autologout.name: AutoLogout
autologout.summary: Idle time after which the user session expires, in seconds or with a time suffix: 0 never expires, otherwise 90 seconds to 1 day. Defaults to 15m.

lang.name: Language
lang.summary: Locale the frontend uses for this user, such as en_US; default follows the system-wide setting.

theme.name: Theme
theme.summary: Frontend theme of the user, or default for the system default.

timezone.name: Timezone
timezone.summary: Time zone of the user, such as Europe/London, or default for the system default.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.summary: Automatic page refresh period, in seconds or with a time suffix, up to 1 hour. Defaults to 30s.

rows_per_page.name: RowsPerPage
rows_per_page.summary: Number of rows shown per page in frontend lists, from 1 to 999999. Defaults to 50.

url.name: Url
url.summary: Frontend page the user is sent to after logging in.

default_maintenance_period.summary: Default duration offered when this user creates a maintenance, from 5 minutes to 999 days 23 hours 59 minutes; rounded down to whole minutes. Defaults to 1h.

userdirectoryid.name: UserDirectoryId
userdirectoryid.summary: The unique identifier of the user directory.

name.name: Name
name.summary: Unique user directory name; an LDAP directory requires it, and the SAML directory leaves it empty unless an update sets it.

idp_type.name: IdpType
idp_type.summary: The authentication protocol of the identity provider behind the directory, LDAP or SAML; only one SAML directory can exist.

description.name: Description
description.summary: A free-form description of the user directory; applies to LDAP directories.

host.name: Host
host.summary: Host name or IP address of the LDAP server.

port.name: Port
port.summary: The TCP port of the LDAP server.

base_dn.name: BaseDn
base_dn.summary: The LDAP base path under which user accounts are searched, for example ou=Users,dc=example,dc=org; for direct user binding it contains the %{user} placeholder.

search_attribute.name: SearchAttribute
search_attribute.summary: The LDAP attribute matched against the login name to find the user account, for example uid or sAMAccountName.

bind_dn.name: BindDn
bind_dn.summary: The distinguished name of the LDAP account used to bind and search the server; empty for anonymous binding and for direct user binding.

start_tls.name: StartTls
start_tls.summary: Whether the LDAP connection is upgraded to TLS with StartTLS; must be off for ldaps:// servers. Off by default.

search_filter.name: SearchFilter
search_filter.summary: A custom LDAP filter used to locate the user account at login, with the %{attr} and %{user} placeholders; the server uses (%{attr}=%{user}) when empty.

provision_status.name: ProvisionStatus
provision_status.summary: Whether users authenticated through this directory are provisioned automatically; provisioning also requires LDAP or SAML just-in-time provisioning to be enabled in the authentication settings. Disabled by default.

group_basedn.name: GroupBaseDn
group_basedn.summary: The LDAP base path under which groups are searched for the group membership check; ignored during provisioning when a group membership attribute is set.

group_name.name: GroupName
group_name.summary: The directory attribute that holds the group name used to map directory groups to Zabbix user groups, for example cn.

group_member.name: GroupMember
group_member.summary: The LDAP group attribute that lists the members of a group, used for the group membership check; ignored during provisioning when a group membership attribute is set.

user_ref_attr.name: UserRefAttr
user_ref_attr.summary: The LDAP user attribute whose value replaces the %{ref} placeholder in the group filter, for example cn or uid.

group_filter.name: GroupFilter
group_filter.summary: The LDAP filter used to find the groups a user belongs to, with the %{attr}, %{groupattr}, %{host}, %{user} and %{ref} placeholders; defaults to (%{groupattr}=%{user}) and is ignored during provisioning when a group membership attribute is set.

group_membership.name: GroupMembership
group_membership.summary: The LDAP user attribute that lists the groups the user belongs to, for example memberOf.

user_username.name: UserUsername
user_username.summary: The directory attribute (also the SCIM attribute when SCIM provisioning is on) whose value becomes the name of a provisioned user, for example givenName or displayName.

user_lastname.name: UserLastname
user_lastname.summary: The directory attribute (also the SCIM attribute when SCIM provisioning is on) whose value becomes the surname of a provisioned user, for example sn.

provision_media.name: ProvisionMedia
provision_media.summary: The media type mappings that create user media for provisioned users from directory attributes; returned when selectProvisionMedia is requested.

idp_entityid.name: IdpEntityId
idp_entityid.summary: The URI that identifies the SAML identity provider in SAML messages.

sso_url.name: SsoUrl
sso_url.summary: Address that receives authentication requests: the identity provider's SAML single sign-on endpoint.

slo_url.name: SloUrl
slo_url.summary: The URL of the identity provider's SAML single logout service, to which logout requests are sent.

sp_entityid.name: SpEntityId
sp_entityid.summary: The identifier of Zabbix as the SAML service provider, a URL or any string.

username_attribute.name: UsernameAttribute
username_attribute.summary: The SAML attribute (also the SCIM attribute when SCIM provisioning is on) whose value is compared with the Zabbix username at login.

nameid_format.name: NameIdFormat
nameid_format.summary: The SAML name ID format requested from the identity provider, for example urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent.

sign_messages.name: SignMessages
sign_messages.summary: Whether SAML messages are signed. Off by default.

sign_assertions.name: SignAssertions
sign_assertions.summary: Whether SAML assertions are signed. Off by default.

sign_authn_requests.name: SignAuthnRequests
sign_authn_requests.summary: Whether SAML authentication requests are signed. Off by default.

sign_logout_requests.name: SignLogoutRequests
sign_logout_requests.summary: Whether SAML logout requests are signed. Off by default.

sign_logout_responses.name: SignLogoutResponses
sign_logout_responses.summary: Whether SAML logout responses are signed. Off by default.

encrypt_nameid.name: EncryptNameId
encrypt_nameid.summary: Whether the SAML name ID is encrypted. Off by default.

encrypt_assertions.name: EncryptAssertions
encrypt_assertions.summary: Whether SAML assertions are encrypted. Off by default.

scim_status.name: ScimStatus
scim_status.summary: Whether SCIM provisioning is enabled for the SAML directory. Off by default.

idp_certificate_hash.summary: The MD5 hash of the stored identity provider certificate, or an empty string when none is stored; available only when SAML certificates are kept in the database.

sp_certificate_hash.summary: The MD5 hash of the stored service provider certificate, or an empty string when none is stored; available only when SAML certificates are kept in the database.

sp_private_key_hash.summary: The MD5 hash of the stored service provider private key, or an empty string when none is stored; available only when SAML certificates are kept in the database.

UserDirectoryGetParameters.summary: Query parameters for the user directory .get API method.

userdirectoryids.name: UserDirectoryIds
userdirectoryids.summary: Limits the result to the user directories whose IDs are listed.

selectProvisionMedia.name: SelectProvisionMedia
selectProvisionMedia.summary: Return the media type mappings of the directory in a provision_media property.

selectProvisionGroups.name: SelectProvisionGroups
selectProvisionGroups.summary: Return the provisioning group mappings of the directory in a provision_groups property.

output.name: Output
output.summary: Which properties to return for each object, given as a list of property names or extend to return all of them.

filter.name: Filter
filter.summary: Return only user directories whose properties exactly match the given values; supports the userdirectoryid, idp_type and provision_status properties.

search.name: Search
search.summary: Return only user directories whose name or description contains the given strings, using a case-insensitive substring match by default.

searchWildcardsEnabled.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
searchWildcardsEnabled.summary: Whether an asterisk in a search string acts as a wildcard that matches any sequence of characters.

searchByAny.name: SearchByAny
searchByAny.summary: Whether an object that matches any one of the search or filter criteria is returned; by default every criterion must match.

startSearch.name: StartSearch
startSearch.summary: Whether the search strings must match the beginning of the property value rather than any part of it.

excludeSearch.name: ExcludeSearch
excludeSearch.summary: Whether to return the objects that do not match the search criteria instead of those that do.

limit.name: Limit
limit.summary: The maximum number of user directories to return.

sortfield.name: SortField
sortfield.summary: The properties to sort the result by; accepted values are name.

sortorder.name: SortOrder
sortorder.summary: The sort direction for each sort field, ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC); ascending when omitted.

countOutput.name: CountOutput
countOutput.summary: Whether to return the number of matching user directories instead of the user directories themselves.

preservekeys.name: PreserveKeys
preservekeys.summary: Whether the result is keyed by object ID instead of being returned as a plain array.

selectUsrgrps.summary: Return the user groups that use the directory in a usrgrps property; accepts count to return only their number.
selectUsrgrps.name: SelectUserGroups

name.name: Name
name.summary: Name of the media mapping.

mediatypeid.name: MediaTypeId
mediatypeid.summary: ID of the media type of the media that provisioned users receive.

attribute.name: Attribute
attribute.summary: Name of the directory attribute that holds the send-to address for the media.

active.summary: Whether the media is enabled: 0 enabled, 1 disabled.

period.summary: When the media is active, as a time period such as "1-7,00:00-24:00", which is the default; user macros are allowed.

severity.summary: Event severities the media is used for, as a bitmask: 1 not classified, 2 information, 4 warning, 8 average, 16 high, 32 disaster. The default is 63, all severities.

UserGetParameters.summary: Query parameters for the user .get API method.

userids.name: UserIds
userids.summary: Limits the result to the users whose IDs are listed.

usrgrpids.name: UserGroupIds
usrgrpids.summary: Keeps users who are members of any of the listed user groups.

mediatypeids.name: MediaTypeIds
mediatypeids.summary: Return only users that have media of the given media types.

selectMedias.name: SelectMedias
selectMedias.summary: Return a medias property with the user's notification media.

selectUsrgrps.name: SelectUserGroups
selectUsrgrps.summary: Return a usrgrps property with the user groups the user belongs to.

selectRole.name: SelectRole
selectRole.summary: Return a role property with the user's role.

getAccess.name: GetAccess
getAccess.summary: If set, add each user's frontend access method, debug mode and disabled status to the result.

output.name: Output
output.summary: The user properties to return: a list of property names, or extend for all of them. The object ID is always included. Defaults to extend.

filter.name: Filter
filter.summary: Exact-match filter: an object whose keys are user properties and whose values are a single value or an array of accepted values. Text-type properties are not supported.

search.name: Search
search.summary: Case-insensitive pattern search: an object whose keys are user properties and whose values are substrings to look for. By default a value matches anywhere in the property.

searchWildcardsEnabled.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
searchWildcardsEnabled.summary: If true, an asterisk in a search value acts as a wildcard. Defaults to false.

searchByAny.name: SearchByAny
searchByAny.summary: If true, return results that match any of the filter or search criteria rather than all of them. Defaults to false.

startSearch.name: StartSearch
startSearch.summary: If true, the search criteria match only at the beginning of a property value instead of anywhere in it. Ignored when wildcards are enabled.

excludeSearch.name: ExcludeSearch
excludeSearch.summary: If true, return the results that do not match the search criteria.

limit.name: Limit
limit.summary: Maximum number of records to return.

sortfield.name: SortField
sortfield.summary: Properties to sort the result by. Allowed values: userid, username. Without it the result is unsorted.

sortorder.name: SortOrder
sortorder.summary: Sort direction, ascending or descending; when a list is given, each entry applies to the sort field at the same position. Defaults to ascending.

countOutput.name: CountOutput
countOutput.summary: If true, return the number of matching records instead of the records themselves.

editable.name: Editable
editable.summary: If true, a user who is not a Super admin gets only their own record. Defaults to false.

preservekeys.name: PreserveKeys
preservekeys.summary: If true, key the result by object ID instead of returning a plain array.

current.summary: If true, return only the user that makes the request. Defaults to false.

mediaids.summary: Keeps users that own any of the listed media.

selectMediatypes.summary: Return a mediatypes property with the media types the user's media use.

UserGroup.summary: The user group read model, as returned by the Zabbix API.

usrgrpid.name: UserGroupId
usrgrpid.summary: User group ID.

name.name: Name
name.summary: The unique name of the user group.

gui_access.name: GuiAccess
gui_access.summary: How members of the group authenticate to the frontend: the system default method, internal authentication, LDAP, or no frontend access at all.

users_status.name: UsersStatus
users_status.summary: Whether the members of the group are enabled; when disabled, they cannot log in or use the API.

debug_mode.name: DebugMode
debug_mode.summary: Whether debug mode is enabled in the frontend for members of the group.

mfa_status.name: MfaStatus
mfa_status.summary: Whether multi-factor authentication is required for members of the group.

mfaid.name: MfaId
mfaid.summary: The ID of the multi-factor authentication method the group uses; 0 means the default method. Applies only when multi-factor authentication is enabled.

userdirectoryid.name: UserDirectoryId
userdirectoryid.summary: The ID of the user directory used to authenticate members of the group; applies when frontend access uses the system default method or LDAP.

users.name: Users
users.summary: The users that belong to the group.

hostgroup_rights.name: HostGroupRights
hostgroup_rights.summary: The permissions the group has on host groups; each entry pairs a host group ID with deny, read-only or read-write access.

templategroup_rights.name: TemplateGroupRights
templategroup_rights.summary: The permissions the group has on template groups; each entry pairs a template group ID with deny, read-only or read-write access.

tag_filters.name: TagFilters
tag_filters.summary: The tag-based permissions of the group; each entry limits access in a host group to problems whose tags match the given tag name and value.

proxy_group_mode.summary: Whether the proxy group access list of the group is an allow list, granting access to only the listed proxy groups, or a deny list, granting access to every proxy group except them.

proxy_mode.summary: Whether the proxy access list of the group is an allow list, granting access to only the listed proxies, or a deny list, granting access to every proxy except them; covers proxies that are not in a proxy group.

UserGroupCreateRequest.summary: Request model for user group creation.

name.name: Name
name.summary: The unique name of the user group.

gui_access.name: GuiAccess
gui_access.summary: How members of the group authenticate to the frontend: the system default method, internal authentication, LDAP, or no frontend access at all. The default is the system default method.

users_status.name: UsersStatus
users_status.summary: Whether the members of the group are enabled; when disabled, they cannot log in or use the API. The default is enabled.

hostgroup_rights.name: HostGroupRights
hostgroup_rights.summary: The permissions the group has on host groups; each entry pairs a host group ID with deny, read-only or read-write access.

templategroup_rights.name: TemplateGroupRights
templategroup_rights.summary: The permissions the group has on template groups; each entry pairs a template group ID with deny, read-only or read-write access.

userids.name: UserIds
userids.summary: IDs of the users to place in the group; deprecated in 7.0 and removed in 7.4. Use <see cref="Users"/>.

tag_filters.name: TagFilters
tag_filters.summary: The tag-based permissions of the group; each entry limits access in a host group to problems whose tags match the given tag name and value.

debug_mode.summary: Whether debug mode is enabled in the frontend for members of the group. The default is disabled.

mfa_status.summary: Whether multi-factor authentication is required for members of the group. The default is disabled.

mfaid.summary: The ID of the multi-factor authentication method the group uses; 0 means the default method. Applies only when multi-factor authentication is enabled.

proxies.summary: The proxies in the proxy access list of the group.

proxy_group_mode.summary: Whether the proxy group access list of the group is an allow list, granting access to only the listed proxy groups, or a deny list, granting access to every proxy group except them. The default is allow list.

proxy_groups.summary: The proxy groups in the proxy group access list of the group.

proxy_mode.summary: Whether the proxy access list of the group is an allow list, granting access to only the listed proxies, or a deny list, granting access to every proxy except them; covers proxies that are not in a proxy group. The default is allow list.

rights.summary: The permissions the group has on host groups. Deprecated in Zabbix 7.0 and removed in 7.4; use the host group rights instead.

userdirectoryid.summary: The ID of the user directory used to authenticate members of the group; applies when frontend access uses the system default method or LDAP.

users.summary: The users to place in the group, identified by user ID.

UserGroupGetParameters.summary: Query parameters for the user group .get API method.

usrgrpids.name: UserGroupIds
usrgrpids.summary: Limits the result to the user groups whose IDs are listed.

userids.name: UserIds
userids.summary: Keeps user groups with any listed user as a member.

status.name: Status
status.summary: Filters user groups by status, where 0 is enabled and 1 is disabled.

selectUsers.name: SelectUsers
selectUsers.summary: Return the members of each user group in the users property.

selectHostGroupRights.name: SelectHostGroupRights
selectHostGroupRights.summary: Return the host group permissions of each user group in the hostgroup_rights property.

selectTemplateGroupRights.name: SelectTemplateGroupRights
selectTemplateGroupRights.summary: Return the template group permissions of each user group in the templategroup_rights property.

selectTagFilters.name: SelectTagFilters
selectTagFilters.summary: Return the tag-based permissions of each user group in the tag_filters property.

output.name: Output
output.summary: The user group properties to return, either as a list of property names or as extend for all of them; extend is the default.

filter.name: Filter
filter.summary: Return only user groups whose properties exactly match the given values; each key is a property name and each value is a single value or an array of accepted values.

search.name: Search
search.summary: Return only user groups whose string properties match the given patterns; by default a property matches when it contains the text, without regard to case.

searchWildcardsEnabled.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
searchWildcardsEnabled.summary: When true, an asterisk in a search pattern matches any sequence of characters.

searchByAny.name: SearchByAny
searchByAny.summary: When true, return user groups that match any of the search patterns instead of all of them.

startSearch.name: StartSearch
startSearch.summary: When true, a search pattern matches only at the start of the property value instead of anywhere in it.

excludeSearch.name: ExcludeSearch
excludeSearch.summary: When true, return user groups that do not match the search patterns.

limit.name: Limit
limit.summary: The maximum number of user groups to return.

sortfield.name: SortField

sortorder.name: SortOrder
sortorder.summary: The direction for each sort property: ASC for ascending, the default, or DESC for descending.

countOutput.name: CountOutput

editable.name: Editable
editable.summary: When true, return only user groups the caller has write permission for.

preservekeys.name: PreserveKeys
preservekeys.summary: When true, return the result as an object keyed by user group ID instead of an array.

mfa_status.summary: Return only user groups with the given multi-factor authentication status: 0 disabled, 1 enabled.

mfaids.summary: Return only user groups that use the given multi-factor authentication methods. Available only to super admins.

proxyids.summary: Return only user groups whose proxy access list contains the given proxies. Available only to super admins.

selectProxyGroups.summary: Return the proxy group access list of each user group in the proxy_groups property. Available only to super admins.

selectRights.summary: Return the host group permissions of each user group in the rights property. Deprecated in Zabbix 7.0 and removed in 7.4; use the host group rights selection instead.

output.name: Output

filter.name: Filter

search.name: Search
search.summary: Return only macros whose properties contain the given strings, using a case-insensitive substring match by default; each key is a property name.

searchWildcardsEnabled.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
searchWildcardsEnabled.summary: Whether an asterisk in a search string acts as a wildcard that matches any sequence of characters.

searchByAny.name: SearchByAny
searchByAny.summary: Whether an object that matches any one of the search or filter criteria is returned; by default every criterion must match.

startSearch.name: StartSearch
startSearch.summary: Whether the search strings must match the beginning of the property value rather than any part of it.

excludeSearch.name: ExcludeSearch
excludeSearch.summary: Whether to return the objects that do not match the search criteria instead of those that do.

limit.name: Limit
limit.summary: The maximum number of macros to return.

sortfield.name: SortField
sortfield.summary: The properties to sort the result by; accepted values are macro.

sortorder.name: SortOrder
sortorder.summary: The sort direction for each sort field, ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC); ascending when omitted.

countOutput.name: CountOutput
countOutput.summary: Whether to return the number of matching macros instead of the macros themselves.

editable.name: Editable
editable.summary: Whether to return only macros that the current user is allowed to change.

preservekeys.name: PreserveKeys
preservekeys.summary: Whether the result is keyed by object ID instead of being returned as a plain array.

groupids.summary: Return only host macros of hosts or templates in the given host groups or template groups.

inherited.summary: When true, return only macros of host prototypes inherited from a template; when false, only macros of objects that are not inherited.

selectGroups.summary: Return the host groups and template groups of the host macro in a groups property. Deprecated in favour of selectHostGroups and selectTemplateGroups, and accepted only by Zabbix 7.0.

selectHostGroups.summary: Return the host groups of the host that owns the macro in a hostgroups property; applies to host macros only.

selectTemplateGroups.summary: Return the template groups of the template that owns the macro in a templategroups property; applies to template macros only.

mediatypeid.name: MediaTypeId
mediatypeid.summary: The ID of the media type used to send notifications.

sendto.name: SendTo
sendto.summary: The addresses, user names or other recipient identifiers that notifications are sent to.

severity.name: Severity
severity.summary: The problem severities that the media is used for, as a bitmask: 1 not classified, 2 information, 4 warning, 8 average, 16 high, 32 disaster. Defaults to 63, all severities.

period.name: Period
period.summary: When the media is active, as a time period specification; defaults to 1-7,00:00-24:00.

provisioned.summary: Whether the media was created by user provisioning from a user directory.

userdirectory_mediaid.summary: The ID of the user directory media mapping that provisioned the media; 0 when the media was not provisioned.

name.name: Name
name.summary: Value map name; no two maps on a host or template may share it.

hostid.name: HostId
hostid.summary: The host or template that owns the value map, by ID.

mappings.name: Mappings
mappings.summary: The rules that translate item values into display text, applied in order.

uuid.summary: The universally unique identifier of the value map, used to match value maps when templates are imported; set only for value maps that belong to templates.

filter.name: Filter

search.name: Search
search.summary: Return only value maps whose string properties match the given patterns; by default a property matches when it contains the text, without regard to case.

searchWildcardsEnabled.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
searchWildcardsEnabled.summary: When true, an asterisk in a search pattern matches any sequence of characters.

searchByAny.name: SearchByAny
searchByAny.summary: When true, return value maps that match any of the search patterns instead of all of them.

startSearch.name: StartSearch
startSearch.summary: When true, a search pattern matches only at the start of the property value instead of anywhere in it.

excludeSearch.name: ExcludeSearch

limit.name: Limit
limit.summary: The maximum number of value maps to return.

sortfield.name: SortField

sortorder.name: SortOrder
sortorder.summary: The direction for each sort property: ASC for ascending, the default, or DESC for descending.

countOutput.name: CountOutput

editable.name: Editable

preservekeys.name: PreserveKeys

type.summary: How the original value is matched: 0 equals, 1 is greater than or equal to, 2 is less than or equal to, 3 is within a range, 4 matches a regular expression, 5 default mapping for unmatched values.

value.name: Value
value.summary: Original value, range, or regular expression to match, depending on the mapping type; empty for the default mapping.

newvalue.name: NewValue
newvalue.summary: Value shown in place of a matching original value.

dchecks.name: Checks
dchecks.summary: Checks the rule performs on each address; replaces the existing checks.

concurrency_max.summary: Maximum number of checks the rule runs at the same time: 0 for unlimited, 1 for one at a time, or up to 999. Defaults to 0.

druleid.summary: ID of the network discovery rule to update. Required.

iprange.summary: Addresses to scan, as a comma-separated list of single IP addresses, ranges such as 192.168.1.1-255, and CIDR subnets; each range may cover at most 65536 addresses.

status.summary: Whether the rule is enabled; a disabled rule does not scan.

proxyid.summary: ID of the proxy that runs the discovery; 0 for the server.

delay.summary: How often the rule runs, as a time unit with a suffix (30s, 1h) or a user macro.

esc_period.name: EscalationPeriod
esc_period.summary: The default duration of an escalation step, as a time unit from 60 seconds to 1 week; applies to trigger, internal and service actions.

eventsource.summary: The type of event the action handles: trigger, discovery, autoregistration, internal or service events.

filter.summary: The conditions that decide which events the action handles and how they combine.

name.summary: The unique name of the action.

notify_if_canceled.summary: Whether users are notified when an escalation is canceled; applies only to trigger actions.

operations.summary: The operations the action runs when a problem or other event occurs.

pause_suppressed.summary: Whether escalations are paused while the problem is suppressed; applies only to trigger actions.

pause_symptoms.summary: Whether escalations are paused for symptom problems; applies only to trigger actions.

recovery_operations.summary: The operations the action runs when the problem is resolved; applies to trigger, internal and service actions.

status.summary: Whether the action is enabled; a disabled action runs no operations.

update_operations.summary: The operations the action runs when the problem is updated; applies to trigger and service actions.

passwd.name: Password
passwd.summary: Password the media type authenticates to the SMTP server with.

access_expires_in.summary: The lifetime of the OAuth access token, in seconds.

access_token.summary: The OAuth access token that email media types use to authenticate.

access_token_updated.summary: The time when the OAuth access token was last updated, as a Unix timestamp.

attempt_interval.summary: How long to wait between attempts to send an alert, as a time unit from 0 to 1 hour.

authorization_url.summary: The OAuth provider endpoint that issues the authorization code.

client_id.summary: The client identifier registered with the OAuth provider.

client_secret.summary: The client secret registered with the OAuth provider.

content_type.summary: The message format of email media types: 0 plain text, 1 HTML. Deprecated in Zabbix 7.0 and removed in 7.4; use the message format instead.

description.summary: A free-text description of the media type.

event_menu_name.summary: The label of the event menu entry. Required when the event menu entry is shown.

event_menu_url.summary: The URL that the event menu entry opens; it may use the {EVENT.TAGS.<name>} macro. Required when the event menu entry is shown.

exec_params.summary: The parameters of script media types as one string with each parameter on its own line. Deprecated in Zabbix 7.0 and removed in 7.4; use the parameters list instead.

exec_path.summary: The file name of the alert script that script media types run.

gsm_modem.summary: The serial device of the GSM modem that SMS media types send through.

maxattempts.summary: How many times the server tries to deliver one alert before giving up, from 1 to 100.

maxsessions.summary: The maximum number of alerts the media type sends in parallel, from 0 to 100, where 0 means no limit; SMS media types always use 1.

message_format.summary: Whether email media types send messages as plain text or HTML.

message_templates.summary: The default message templates to set on the media type, one per event source and operation mode.

name.summary: The unique name of the media type.

parameters.summary: The parameters passed to the script or webhook: for script media types an ordered list of values, for webhook media types name and value pairs.

process_tags.summary: Whether the tags returned by a webhook script are added to the problem event.

provider.summary: The email provider preset that email media types use: generic SMTP, Gmail, Gmail relay, Office 365 or Office 365 relay.

redirection_url.summary: The URL in the Zabbix frontend that the OAuth provider redirects to after authorization; used by email media types that authenticate with OAuth.

refresh_token.summary: The OAuth refresh token used to obtain a new access token.

script.summary: The JavaScript code that webhook media types run.

show_event_menu.summary: Whether the media type adds an entry to the event menu in the frontend that opens the event menu URL.

smtp_authentication.summary: How email media types authenticate to the SMTP server: no authentication, user name and password, or OAuth.

smtp_email.summary: The sender address that email media types put on outgoing messages.

smtp_helo.summary: The domain name that email media types announce in the SMTP HELO command.

smtp_port.summary: The port of the SMTP server, from 1 to 65535.

smtp_security.summary: The connection security that email media types use: none, STARTTLS or SSL/TLS.

smtp_server.summary: The SMTP server that email media types send through.

smtp_verify_host.summary: Whether email media types check that the SMTP server host name matches its certificate; applies only when STARTTLS or SSL/TLS is used.

smtp_verify_peer.summary: Whether email media types verify the SMTP server certificate; applies only when STARTTLS or SSL/TLS is used.

status.summary: The media type's on/off switch; while switched off it delivers no alerts.

timeout.summary: How long a webhook script may run, as a time unit from 1 to 60 seconds.

token_url.summary: The OAuth provider endpoint that exchanges the authorization code or refresh token for an access token.

tokens_status.summary: A bitmask that records which OAuth tokens are valid: 1 the access token, 2 the refresh token; 0 means neither.

type.summary: The delivery channel of the media type: email, script, SMS, webhook or push notification.

username.summary: The user name that email media types use for SMTP password authentication.

ssl_key_password.summary: The password that protects the SSL private key file of HTTP agent items.

status.summary: Whether the item is enabled; a disabled item is not polled.

status_codes.summary: The HTTP status codes an HTTP agent response must have to be accepted, as a comma-separated list of codes and ranges such as 200,301-302.

tags.summary: The tags to assign to the item.

time_shift.summary: How far telemetry query items shift their processing window back from the current time, as a time unit from 0 to 1 day.

timeout.summary: How long to wait for the item's data, as a time unit from 1 second to 10 minutes; an empty value uses the timeout configured on the proxy or server for the item type.

trapper_hosts.summary: The addresses or DNS names allowed to send values for trapper items and HTTP agent items that accept trapping, as a comma-separated list; an empty value accepts any host.

type.summary: The kind of check that collects the item's values, such as Zabbix agent, SNMP agent, HTTP agent, calculated, dependent or script.

url.summary: The URL that HTTP agent items request; it may contain user macros.

username.summary: The user name for authentication; used by SSH, Telnet, database monitor, JMX, simple check and HTTP agent items.

uuid.summary: The universally unique identifier of the item, used to match items when templates are imported; set only for items that belong to templates.

valuemapid.summary: The ID of the value map used to display the item's values; applies only to numeric and character items.

verify_host.summary: Whether HTTP agent items check that the host name in the URL matches the server certificate.

verify_peer.summary: Whether HTTP agent items verify the certificate of the web server.

itemid.summary: ID of the item to update.

value_type.summary: Type of the values the item stores: float, character, log, unsigned, text, binary or JSON.

units.summary: Units of the values, such as B or %; B, Bps, s and uptime are scaled when shown.

history.summary: How long the server keeps the values, as a time unit with a suffix (0 keeps none) or a user macro.

trends.summary: How long the server keeps the hourly trends of a numeric item, as a time unit with a suffix (0 keeps none) or a user macro.

params.summary: Parameters of the item type: the formula of a calculated item, the SQL query of a database monitor item, the script of an SSH, Telnet or script item.

delay.summary: Update interval, as a time unit with a suffix (30s, 1m) or a user macro, optionally followed by custom flexible and scheduling intervals separated by semicolons.

interfaceid.summary: ID of the host interface the item is polled through; 0 for a type that uses no interface.

mappings.summary: The mappings of the value map, in evaluation order.

name.summary: Value map name.

newvalue.summary: Value shown in place of a matching original value.

sortorder.summary: Position of the mapping in the evaluation order of the value map, starting from 0.

valuemapid.summary: ID of the value map the mapping belongs to.

operator.summary: How the event name is matched: contains or does not contain. The default is contains.

value.summary: Text matched against the problem event name; must not be empty.

groupid.summary: The ID of a host group whose hosts are put into maintenance.

hostid.summary: ID of a host that the maintenance applies to.

operator.summary: How the event name is matched: 2 contains, 3 does not contain.

value.summary: Text matched against the problem event name.

tag.summary: The name of the problem tag that the maintenance matches.

value.summary: The value that the tag value is compared with.

day.summary: Day of the month, from 1 to 31, on which a monthly period applies; 0 when the period uses days of the week instead.

dayofweek.summary: Days of the week on which a weekly or monthly period applies, as a bitmask where 1 is Monday, 2 is Tuesday, and so on up to 64 for Sunday.

every.summary: Recurrence interval: for daily periods every N days (1 to 999), for weekly periods every N weeks (1 to 99), and for monthly periods with days of the week the week of the month (1 first, 2 second, 3 third, 4 fourth, 5 last).

month.summary: Months in which a monthly period applies, as a bitmask where 1 is January, 2 is February, and so on up to 2048 for December.

period.summary: Maintenance period duration in seconds, at least 5 minutes; when not given, the server applies 1 hour.

start_date.summary: Unix time when a one-time period starts.

start_time.summary: Time of day at which a daily, weekly or monthly period starts (whole seconds after midnight on the wire).

timeperiod_type.summary: How the period recurs: 0 one time only, 2 daily, 3 weekly, 4 monthly.

operator.summary: How the tag value is matched: equals, does not equal, contains or does not contain. The default is contains.

tag.summary: Name of the problem tag that the maintenance matches.

value.summary: Tag value to match; empty matches any value with the contains operator.

day.summary: Day of the month on which a monthly period starts, from 1 to 31; 0 when the period uses days of the week instead.

dayofweek.summary: Days of the week on which the period starts, as a bitmask: 1 Monday, 2 Tuesday, 4 Wednesday, 8 Thursday, 16 Friday, 32 Saturday, 64 Sunday. Required for weekly periods.

every.summary: Recurrence interval: every N days (1 to 999) for daily periods, every N weeks (1 to 99) for weekly periods, or the week of the month (1 first, 2 second, 3 third, 4 fourth, 5 last) for monthly periods with days of the week.

month.summary: Months in which a monthly period starts, as a bitmask: 1 January, 2 February, 4 March, and so on up to 2048 December. Required for monthly periods.

period.summary: Duration of the maintenance window, in seconds or as a time suffix, from 5 minutes to just under 1000 days; the default is 1 hour.

start_date.summary: Start of a one-time period, as a Unix timestamp; used only by one-time periods and defaults to the current time.

start_time.summary: Time of day at which the period starts, from 00:00 to 23:59 (whole seconds after midnight on the wire); used by daily, weekly and monthly periods.

timeperiod_type.summary: How the period recurs: one time only, daily, weekly or monthly.

triggerid.summary: The ID of a trigger that the maintenance covers; supported only by maintenance with data collection.

active_since.summary: The Unix time at which the maintenance becomes active, inclusive and rounded down to the minute.

active_till.summary: End of the maintenance window as a Unix time. The window ends just before this instant, the server truncates it to whole minutes, and it must come after the start.

description.summary: A free-form description of the maintenance.

event_names.summary: Conditions on the problem event name (contains or does not contain a string) that limit which problems the maintenance suppresses; allowed only for maintenance with data collection.

groupids.summary: The IDs of the host groups to place in maintenance. Deprecated in favour of the groups list, and accepted only by Zabbix 7.0.

hostids.summary: The IDs of the hosts to place in maintenance. Deprecated in favour of the hosts list, and accepted only by Zabbix 7.0.

hosts.summary: The hosts placed in maintenance; the given list replaces the existing hosts.

maintenance_type.summary: Whether data is still collected during the maintenance (the default) or collection stops for the affected hosts.

maintenanceid.summary: The identifier of the maintenance to update.

name.summary: The unique name of the maintenance.

tags.summary: The problem tags that select which problems the maintenance suppresses; the given list replaces the existing tags.

tags_evaltype.summary: How the problem tags are combined: And/Or (the default), where tags with different names must all match, or Or, where any tag may match. Allowed only for maintenance with data collection.

timeperiods.summary: The periods during which the maintenance takes effect; the given list replaces the existing periods.

triggers.summary: The triggers whose problems the maintenance applies to; allowed only for maintenance with data collection. At least one host group, host or trigger must be given.

line_type.summary: Style of the line: none, solid, dotted, or dashed.

line_width.summary: Width of the line in pixels, from 0 to 50.

slo.summary: Service level objective as a percentage from 0 to 100 with up to four decimal places; the SLA is not met when the service level indicator falls below it.

status.summary: Whether the SLA is turned on or off.

timezone.summary: Time zone used for reporting, such as Europe/London or UTC.

stats.summary: Alerting statistics to return; the available statistic is the number of alerts. All are returned by default.

top.summary: Ranked lists to return, by media type and by event source.

source.alerts.summary: Number of alert sources to list in the top results, ranked by number of alerts.

request.summary: Parameters of the task: the diagnostic sections to collect, the IDs of the proxies to reload, or the ID of the item to check now, depending on the type. Required.

type.summary: Kind of task: retrieve diagnostic information, reload the configuration cache of proxies, or check an item or discovery rule now. Required.

proxyid.summary: ID of the proxy to collect diagnostic information from; 0, the default, asks the server.

stats.summary: History cache statistics to return: items, values, memory, memory.data or memory.index. All are returned by default.

top.summary: Ranked list of items to return, by the number of values held in the history cache.

values.summary: How many items to list, ranked by the number of values they hold in the history cache.

values.summary: How many low-level discovery rules to list, ranked by the number of values queued for them.

values.summary: How many items to list, ranked by the number of values queued for preprocessing.

top.summary: Settings of the top lists of media types and alert sources ranked by alert count.

source.alerts.summary: How many alert sources to list, ranked by the number of alerts queued for them.

top.summary: Ranked list of items that was requested, by the number of values held in the history cache.

values.summary: Number of entries to list in the top results, ranked by number of values.

values.summary: Number of entries to list in the top results, ranked by number of values.

stats.summary: Preprocessing statistics that were requested: values or preproc.values.

top.summary: Ranked list of items that was requested, by the number of values queued for preprocessing.

values.summary: Number of entries to list in the top results, ranked by number of values.

alerting.summary: The alerting statistics to collect; used by diagnostic information tasks.

historycache.summary: The history cache statistics to collect; used by diagnostic information tasks.

itemid.summary: The ID of the item or low-level discovery rule checked immediately; required by check now tasks.

lld.summary: The low-level discovery statistics to collect; used by diagnostic information tasks.

preprocessing.summary: The preprocessing queue statistics to collect; used by diagnostic information tasks.

proxyids.summary: The IDs of the proxies whose configuration is reloaded; required by proxy configuration reload tasks.

valuecache.summary: The value cache statistics to collect; used by diagnostic information tasks.

stats.summary: Statistics returned about the value cache (items, values, memory, mode), or extend for all of them.

top.summary: Settings of the top list of items in the value cache.

request.values.summary: Number of items to report, ranked by the number of values requested from the value cache.

values.summary: Number of items to report, ranked by the number of values they hold in the value cache.

alerting.summary: Diagnostic information to collect about alerting.

historycache.summary: Diagnostic information to collect about the history cache.

itemid.summary: ID of the item or discovery rule to check immediately; required for a check now task.

lld.summary: Diagnostic information to collect about low-level discovery.

preprocessing.summary: Diagnostic information to collect about preprocessing.

proxyids.summary: IDs of the proxies whose configuration is refreshed; required for a proxy configuration refresh task.

valuecache.summary: Diagnostic information to collect about the value cache.

stats.summary: Value cache statistics to return: items, values, memory or mode. All are returned by default.

top.summary: Ranked lists of items to return, by the number of values cached or requested.

request.values.summary: Number of items to report, ranked by the number of values requested from the value cache.

values.summary: Number of items to report, ranked by the number of values they hold in the value cache.

name.summary: Name of the dashboard page.

pages.summary: Pages of the dashboard, in display order; replaces the current pages. Existing pages are matched by ID.

checked.summary: The macro value set when the checkbox is selected.

value.summary: Value of the macro; for a vault secret, the path to the secret.

description.summary: Free-form description of the template.

macros.summary: User macros of the template; replaces all current macros on the template.

name.summary: Visible name of the template; defaults to the technical name.
name.name: VisibleName

readme.summary: Configuration instructions for the template shown in the Host Wizard, in Markdown.

tags.summary: Tags of the template; replaces all current tags.

templates.summary: Templates linked to the template (its parents), each by its ID; replaces the current links, and a template left out is unlinked with its inherited entities kept.
templates.name: LinkedTemplates

templates_clear.summary: Templates to unlink from the template and whose inherited entities are deleted.

vendor_name.summary: Name of the template vendor; set it together with the vendor version or leave both empty.

vendor_version.summary: Version of the template as given by its vendor; set it together with the vendor name or leave both empty.

mappings.summary: Mappings that translate raw item values into display text.

uuid.summary: Universally unique identifier of the value map, which matches it to the same value map when a configuration is exported and imported.

newvalue.summary: Value shown in place of a matching original value.

sortorder.summary: Position of the mapping in the evaluation order of the value map, starting from 0.

valuemapid.summary: ID of the value map the mapping belongs to.

expires_at.summary: The time the token expires, as a Unix timestamp; 0 means it never expires.

name.summary: The name of the token, unique among the tokens of the same user.

tokenid.summary: The ID of the API token.

ts_disable.summary: Time when an object that is no longer discovered will be disabled, as a Unix timestamp; 0 when no disabling is scheduled.

disable_source.summary: What disabled the object: 0 a user or the default state, 1 low-level discovery.

clock.summary: When the event was created, as a Unix timestamp.

name.summary: The resolved name of the event.

ns.summary: The nanosecond part of the time that the event was created.

object.summary: The kind of object that created the event: 0 trigger, 1 discovered host, 2 discovered service, 3 autoregistered host, 4 item, 5 low-level discovery rule, 6 service.

objectid.summary: The ID of the object that created the event.

severity.summary: The current severity of the event, from 0 (not classified) to 5 (disaster).

source.summary: The kind of event: 0 a trigger event, 1 discovery, 2 autoregistration, 3 internal, 4 a service event.

value.summary: The state of the object that the event records; for trigger events, 0 OK and 1 problem.

flags.summary: What low-level discovery made of the trigger: a plain trigger, a discovery rule or prototype, or one created by discovery.

correlation_mode.summary: Which problems an OK event closes: all problems of the trigger (the default), or only those whose correlation tag values match.

correlation_tag.summary: The tag whose value must match for an OK event to close a problem when correlation by tag is used.

dependencies.summary: The triggers and trigger prototypes that triggers discovered from the prototype depend on.

opdata.summary: The operational data shown with problems, usually item values referenced through macros.

priority.summary: The severity of triggers discovered from the prototype; not classified by default.

parent_triggerid.summary: ID of the trigger prototype the trigger was created from.

ts_disable.summary: Unix time when the trigger, no longer discovered, will be disabled; 0 when no disabling is scheduled.

correlation_tag.summary: Tag whose value must match for an OK event to close a problem when the correlation mode is tag based.

extend.summary: Whether checking the session also prolongs it. Defaults to true; applies only to session tokens.

sessionid.summary: Session token to check. Required when no API token is given.

token.summary: API token to check. Required when no session token is given.

base_dn.summary: The LDAP base path under which user accounts are searched, for example ou=Users,dc=example,dc=org; for direct user binding it contains the %{user} placeholder.

bind_dn.summary: The distinguished name of the LDAP account used to bind and search the server; empty for anonymous binding and for direct user binding.

bind_password.summary: The password of the LDAP bind account; empty for anonymous binding and for direct user binding. It is never returned by the API.

description.summary: A free-form description of the user directory; applies to LDAP directories.

encrypt_assertions.summary: Whether SAML assertions are encrypted. Off by default.

encrypt_nameid.summary: Whether the SAML name ID is encrypted. Off by default.

group_basedn.summary: The LDAP base path under which groups are searched for the group membership check; ignored during provisioning when a group membership attribute is set.

group_filter.summary: The LDAP filter used to find the groups a user belongs to, with the %{attr}, %{groupattr}, %{host}, %{user} and %{ref} placeholders; defaults to (%{groupattr}=%{user}) and is ignored during provisioning when a group membership attribute is set.

group_member.summary: The LDAP group attribute that lists the members of a group, used for the group membership check; ignored during provisioning when a group membership attribute is set.

group_membership.summary: The LDAP user attribute that lists the groups the user belongs to, for example memberOf.

group_name.summary: The directory attribute that holds the group name used to map directory groups to Zabbix user groups, for example cn.

idp_certificate.summary: The PEM content of the identity provider certificate; accepted only when SAML certificates are kept in the database, and never returned by the API.

idp_entityid.summary: The URI that identifies the SAML identity provider in SAML messages.

idp_type.summary: The authentication protocol of the identity provider behind the new directory, LDAP or SAML; required, and only one SAML directory can exist.

name.summary: Unique user directory name; an LDAP directory requires it, and the SAML directory leaves it empty unless an update sets it.

nameid_format.summary: The SAML name ID format requested from the identity provider, for example urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent.

port.summary: The TCP port of the LDAP server.

provision_groups.summary: The mappings from directory group name patterns to the Zabbix user role and user groups assigned to provisioned users; required when provisioning is enabled.

provision_media.summary: The mappings from directory attributes to the user media created for provisioned users, such as an e-mail address.

provision_status.summary: Whether users authenticated through this directory are provisioned automatically; provisioning also requires LDAP or SAML just-in-time provisioning to be enabled in the authentication settings. Disabled by default.

scim_status.summary: Whether SCIM provisioning is enabled for the SAML directory. Off by default.

search_attribute.summary: The LDAP attribute matched against the login name to find the user account, for example uid or sAMAccountName.

search_filter.summary: A custom LDAP filter used to locate the user account at login, with the %{attr} and %{user} placeholders; the server uses (%{attr}=%{user}) when empty.

sign_assertions.summary: Whether SAML assertions are signed. Off by default.

sign_authn_requests.summary: Whether SAML authentication requests are signed. Off by default.

sign_logout_requests.summary: Whether SAML logout requests are signed. Off by default.

sign_logout_responses.summary: Whether SAML logout responses are signed. Off by default.

sign_messages.summary: Whether SAML messages are signed. Off by default.

slo_url.summary: The URL of the identity provider's SAML single logout service, to which logout requests are sent.

sp_certificate.summary: The PEM content of the service provider certificate; accepted only when SAML certificates are kept in the database, and never returned by the API.

sp_entityid.summary: The identifier of Zabbix as the SAML service provider, a URL or any string.

sp_private_key.summary: The PEM content of the service provider private key; accepted only when SAML certificates are kept in the database, and never returned by the API.

sso_url.summary: Address that receives authentication requests: the identity provider's SAML single sign-on endpoint.

start_tls.summary: Whether the LDAP connection is upgraded to TLS with StartTLS; must be off for ldaps:// servers. Off by default.

user_lastname.summary: The directory attribute (also the SCIM attribute when SCIM provisioning is on) whose value becomes the surname of a provisioned user, for example sn.

user_ref_attr.summary: The LDAP user attribute whose value replaces the %{ref} placeholder in the group filter, for example cn or uid.

user_username.summary: The directory attribute (also the SCIM attribute when SCIM provisioning is on) whose value becomes the name of a provisioned user, for example givenName or displayName.

username_attribute.summary: The SAML attribute (also the SCIM attribute when SCIM provisioning is on) whose value is compared with the Zabbix username at login.

host.summary: Host name or IP address of the LDAP server.

name.summary: The pattern that matches the names of user directory groups to map; the * wildcard is supported.

roleid.summary: The ID of the role given to provisioned users in the matching group.

user_groups.summary: The Zabbix user groups that provisioned users in the matching group are added to.

usrgrpid.summary: ID of the user group that provisioned users are added to.

attribute.summary: The identity provider attribute that holds the send-to address.

mediatypeid.summary: The ID of the media type created for provisioned users.

name.summary: The name of the media mapping.

period.summary: When the media is active, as a time period specification; defaults to 1-7,00:00-24:00.

severity.summary: The problem severities that the media is used for, as a bitmask: 1 not classified, 2 information, 4 warning, 8 average, 16 high, 32 disaster. Defaults to 63, all severities.

name.summary: Name of the group in the identity provider that this mapping matches; the * wildcard is allowed.

roleid.summary: ID of the user role given to provisioned users who belong to the matching group.

user_groups.summary: Zabbix user groups that provisioned users of the matching group are added to.

usrgrpid.summary: ID of a user group that provisioned users are added to.
